functions.description: Sets the shared pointer to the irregular patch for this surface. Passing a null pointer clears the association.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::Options::SetDefaultFVarID
functions.description: Assigns the default face-varying channel ID to be used by a SurfaceFactory when no explicit face-varying ID is provided. Chainable setter on Options.
requirements: Options instance must be valid and mutable.
The provided face-varying ID (id) should correspond to a valid face-varying channel in the target mesh (inferred from purpose).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::Options::EnableCaching
functions.description: Enables or disables internal/external caching used by SurfaceFactory. Chainable setter on Options.
requirements: Options instance must be valid and mutable.
The on parameter selects whether caching is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::Options::SetExternalCache
functions.description: Assigns an external cache instance for the factory to use instead of its internal cache. Chainable setter on Options.
requirements: Options instance must be valid and mutable.
The cache pointer c may be null to clear an external cache; if non-null it must outlive any SurfaceFactory using it (inferred typical ownership requirement).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::Options::SetApproxLevelSmooth
functions.description: Sets the maximum refinement level used to approximate the limit surface for smooth features. Value is stored internally as an unsigned char.
requirements: Options instance must be valid and mutable.
level should be a non-negative integer; values larger than 255 will be truncated to unsigned char range (inferred from implementation cast).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::Options::SetApproxLevelSharp
functions.description: Sets the maximum refinement level used to approximate the limit surface for sharp features. Value is stored internally as an unsigned char.
requirements: Options instance must be valid and mutable.
level should be a non-negative integer; values larger than 255 will be truncated to unsigned char range (inferred from implementation cast).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::~SurfaceFactory
functions.description: Destructor for SurfaceFactory. Cleans up any resources held by the factory instance.
requirements: The SurfaceFactory object must not be used after destruction.
Any external cache provided via Options should be managed by the caller; the factory does not imply ownership (inferred from SetExternalCache semantics).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::GetSchemeType
functions.description: Returns the subdivision scheme type associated with this factory (e.g., Catmull-Clark, Loop).
requirements: Factory must have been constructed with valid scheme information (guaranteed by constructor).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::GetSchemeOptions
functions.description: Returns the subdivision scheme options associated with this factory.
requirements: Factory must have been constructed with valid options (guaranteed by constructor).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::FaceHasLimitSurface
functions.description: Determines whether the specified face has an associated limit surface suitable for Surface initialization. Returns false for faces marked as holes or when uncommon boundary interpolation options preclude a limit surface.
requirements: faceIndex must refer to a valid face in the connected mesh (inferred from purpose).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::GetFaceParameterization
functions.description: Returns the parameterization of the specified face. Intended for faces that have a limit surface.
requirements: faceIndex must refer to a face with an existing limit surface; behavior is undefined if no limit surface exists (stated by comment: presumed to have a limit surface).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::InitVertexSurface
functions.signature: template <typename REAL> bool InitVertexSurface(Index faceIndex, Surface<REAL> * surface) const
functions.description: Initializes the provided Surface object to represent the limit surface for vertex-interpolated data on the given face. Returns true on success.
requirements: surface must be a non-null pointer to a valid Surface<REAL> instance.
faceIndex must refer to a valid face that has a limit surface; initialization fails otherwise.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).
On failure, the output Surface remains uninitialized for evaluation (inferred typical behavior).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::InitVaryingSurface
functions.signature: template <typename REAL> bool InitVaryingSurface(Index faceIndex, Surface<REAL> * surface) const
functions.description: Initializes the provided Surface object to represent the limit surface for varying-interpolated data on the given face. Returns true on success.
requirements: surface must be a non-null pointer to a valid Surface<REAL> instance.
faceIndex must refer to a valid face that has a limit surface; initialization fails otherwise.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::InitFaceVaryingSurface
functions.signature: template <typename REAL> bool InitFaceVaryingSurface(Index faceIndex, Surface<REAL> * surface) const
functions.description: Initializes the provided Surface object for the default face-varying channel on the given face. The default face-varying ID must have been set in Options. Returns true on success.
requirements: surface must be a non-null pointer to a valid Surface<REAL> instance.
A default face-varying ID must have been assigned in Options prior to use (stated).
faceIndex must refer to a valid face that has a limit surface; initialization fails otherwise.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::InitSurfaces
functions.signature: template <typename REAL> bool InitSurfaces(Index faceIndex, Surface<REAL> * vtxSurface, Surface<REAL> * fvarSurfaces, FVarID const fvarIDs[] = 0, int fvarCount = 0, Surface<REAL> * varSurface = 0) const
functions.description: Initializes multiple Surface objects at once for the specified face: vertex, varying, and/or one or more face-varying channels. Optimizes by avoiding repeated work when multiple non-linear surfaces are needed. Returns true if all requested surfaces were successfully constructed.
requirements: Any non-null Surface pointers (vtxSurface, varSurface, fvarSurfaces) must point to valid Surface<REAL> instances.
If fvarSurfaces is provided and fvarCount > 0, fvarIDs must either be null (to use an implied sequence [0..fvarCount-1]) or point to an array of fvarCount valid face-varying IDs (as documented).
If fvarSurfaces is provided with fvarIDs == 0 and fvarCount == 0, the factory’s default face-varying ID must have been set in Options (stated).
faceIndex must refer to a valid face that has a limit surface; initialization fails otherwise.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::CreateVertexSurface
functions.signature: template <typename REAL=float> Surface<REAL> * CreateVertexSurface(Index faceIndex) const
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new Surface representing the vertex-interpolated limit surface for the given face. Returns a heap-allocated pointer on success; returns nullptr and deletes the allocation on failure.
requirements: Caller assumes ownership of the returned Surface and must delete it when done.
faceIndex should refer to a face with a limit surface; otherwise nullptr is returned.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::CreateVaryingSurface
functions.signature: template <typename REAL=float> Surface<REAL> * CreateVaryingSurface(Index faceIndex) const
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new Surface representing the varying-interpolated limit surface for the given face. Returns a heap-allocated pointer on success; returns nullptr on failure.
requirements: Caller assumes ownership of the returned Surface and must delete it when done.
faceIndex should refer to a face with a limit surface; otherwise nullptr is returned.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactory::CreateFaceVaryingSurface
functions.signature: template <typename REAL=float> Surface<REAL> * CreateFaceVaryingSurface(Index faceIndex) const
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a new Surface for the default face-varying channel on the given face. Returns a heap-allocated pointer on success; returns nullptr on failure.
requirements: A default face-varying ID must have been assigned in Options prior to use (stated).
Caller assumes ownership of the returned Surface and must delete it when done.
faceIndex should refer to a face with a limit surface; otherwise nullptr is returned.
Template parameter REAL must be compatible with Surface<REAL> (typically a floating-point type).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::isFaceHole
functions.description: Returns whether the specified face is tagged as a hole. Intended for topology queries by SurfaceFactory; subclasses must implement to report mesh-specific hole flags.
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
May be called frequently by the factory; implementation should be efficient.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceSize
functions.description: Returns the number of vertices of the specified face (face valence). Used to size buffers and to detect linear cases.
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
Return value must be the exact vertex count of the face and non-negative.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceVertexIndices
functions.description: Fills vertexIndices with the control-vertex indices for the face’s corners. Enables fast handling of linear limit surfaces without inspecting neighborhood topology. Returns an int (presumably the number of indices written, typically the face size).
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
vertexIndices must point to writable storage large enough to hold getFaceSize(faceIndex) entries; null is not documented as allowed for this method.
Indices for the face must be provided in the face’s natural order.
Return value should match the number of indices written (typically the face size).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceFVarValueIndices
functions.description: Fills fvarValueIndices with the face-varying value indices associated with each vertex of the face for the specified face-varying channel. Used for linear face-varying evaluation. Returns an int (presumably the number of indices written, typically the face size).
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
fvarID identifies the face-varying channel; it is an intptr_t and may be an integer ID or pointer as defined by the subclass; it must be recognized by the implementation.
fvarValueIndices must point to writable storage large enough to hold getFaceSize(faceIndex) entries; null is not documented as allowed for this method.
Indices must correspond one-to-one with the face’s vertices in face order.
Return value should match the number of indices written (typically the face size).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::populateFaceVertexDescriptor
functions.signature: int OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::populateFaceVertexDescriptor(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::Index faceIndex, int faceVertex, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor * vertexDescriptor) const
functions.description: Populates vertexDescriptor with a complete description of the topology around a specific corner (face-vertex) of the given face, including incident faces and sharpness. The return value is an int; the exact meaning is not explicitly documented here, but is likely related to the number of incident faces or a status code.
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
faceVertex must be a valid corner index in the range [0, getFaceSize(faceIndex) - 1].
vertexDescriptor must be a valid, non-null pointer to a VertexDescriptor instance to be filled.
The described neighborhood must include the complete set of incident faces around the face-vertex and any sharpness at or around it.
Ordering and conventions in the descriptor must be consistent with what subsequent index-gathering methods will use.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceVertexIncidentFaceVertexIndices
functions.signature: int OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceVertexIncidentFaceVertexIndices(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::Index faceIndex, int faceVertex, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::Index vertexIndices[]) const
functions.description: Gathers the control-vertex indices for all incident faces around the specified face-vertex (corner). The indices for each incident face must be ordered starting at the face-vertex corner and follow the face around that corner. Incident faces must be listed in the same order as described by the previously populated VertexDescriptor. Returns an int (presumably the number of indices written).
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
faceVertex must be a valid corner index in the range [0, getFaceSize(faceIndex) - 1].
vertexIndices must point to writable storage large enough to hold the concatenated indices for all incident faces; the total count equals the sum of the sizes of the incident faces.
For each incident face, indices must be ordered relative to the face-vertex corner; e.g., for face {A,B,C,D} when at corner C, supply {C,D,A,B}.
The sequence of incident faces must match the order specified by the VertexDescriptor returned by populateFaceVertexDescriptor for the same faceVertex.
All incident faces around the corner must be included; partial results are not permitted.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceVertexIncidentFaceFVarValueIndices
functions.signature: int OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceVertexIncidentFaceFVarValueIndices(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::Index faceIndex, int faceVertex, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::FVarID fvarID, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::Index fvarValueIndices[]) const
functions.description: Gathers the face-varying value indices for all incident faces around the specified face-vertex, for the given face-varying channel. Ordering and incident-face sequence must mirror the vertex-index version and the VertexDescriptor, with each face’s indices starting at the face-vertex corner. Returns an int (presumably the number of indices written).
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
faceVertex must be a valid corner index in the range [0, getFaceSize(faceIndex) - 1].
fvarID identifies the face-varying channel; it is an intptr_t and may be an integer ID or pointer as defined by the subclass; it must be recognized by the implementation.
fvarValueIndices must point to writable storage large enough to hold the concatenated indices for all incident faces.
Incident faces must be provided in the same order as in the VertexDescriptor for this face-vertex, and each face’s indices must begin at the face-vertex corner.
All incident faces around the corner must be included; partial results are not permitted.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceNeighborhoodVertexIndicesIfRegular
functions.description: Optional fast path to identify control-vertex indices for the regular patch corresponding to the face’s limit surface, when the neighborhood around the face is purely regular. Returns true if the neighborhood is purely regular and indices are applicable; false otherwise. Default implementation returns false.
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
If vertexIndices is non-null, it must point to writable storage large enough to hold all required control points for the regular patch type of the mesh’s subdivision scheme.
Caller is allowed to pass nullptr for vertexIndices; in that case only the return value is used.
Indices must be ordered according to the regular patch type for the subdivision scheme.
Boundary vertices are permitted and must be represented with an Index value of -1.
Should only report true for purely regular neighborhoods; otherwise return false and do not rely on indices.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryMeshAdapter::getFaceNeighborhoodFVarValueIndicesIfRegular
functions.description: Optional fast path to identify face-varying value indices for the regular patch when the vertex neighborhood around the face is purely regular and the face-varying topology is similar. Returns true if applicable; false otherwise. Default implementation returns false.
requirements: faceIndex must reference a valid face in the mesh.
fvarID identifies the face-varying channel; it is an intptr_t and may be an integer ID or pointer as defined by the subclass; it must be recognized by the implementation.
Caller is allowed to pass nullptr for fvarValueIndices; in that case only the return value is used.
If fvarValueIndices is non-null, it must point to writable storage large enough for the required control points for the regular patch’s face-varying indices.
This method will only be invoked by the factory if the vertex version reports the neighborhood as purely regular; implementations should expect similar topology.
Indices must be ordered according to the regular patch type.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryCache::SurfaceFactoryCache
functions.description: Default constructor for SurfaceFactoryCache. Initializes an empty cache used internally by SurfaceFactory to store/reuse internal representations of irregular patches. Intended for internal use; an instance may be shared across multiple SurfaceFactory objects. Copy and assignment are explicitly deleted, so construct per instance you intend to share by reference or pointer.
requirements: No arguments required.
The constructed object may be shared between SurfaceFactory instances, but callers must ensure appropriate external synchronization if sharing across threads unless using a threaded subclass.
Object must not be copied or assigned (copy constructor and copy assignment are deleted).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryCache::~SurfaceFactoryCache
functions.description: Virtual destructor for SurfaceFactoryCache. Cleans up cache resources. Allows safe polymorphic deletion via a base-class pointer.
requirements: Do not use the object after the destructor has run.
Ensure no concurrent access is in progress at destruction time unless a thread-safe subclass is used and higher-level code guarantees safety.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded::SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded
functions.signature:
template <class MUTEX_TYPE, class READ_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE, class WRITE_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded<MUTEX_TYPE, READ_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE, WRITE_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE>::SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded()
functions.description: Default constructor for the thread-safe SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded adapter. Initializes a cache with internal synchronization so reads and writes are protected by the provided mutex/lock-guard types. Use this when the cache may be accessed from multiple threads.
requirements: Template parameter MUTEX_TYPE must be a mutex type compatible with READ_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE and WRITE_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE (i.e., the lock guards must be constructible from a MUTEX_TYPE instance and provide the appropriate locking semantics).
READ_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE must provide scoped, potentially shared (reader) locking for read operations.
WRITE_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE must provide scoped, exclusive (writer) locking for write operations.
No arguments required to construct.
Do not copy or assign the cache object (copy and assignment are deleted in the base).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded::~SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded
functions.signature:
template <class MUTEX_TYPE, class READ_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE, class WRITE_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded<MUTEX_TYPE, READ_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE, WRITE_LOCK_GUARD_TYPE>::~SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded()
functions.description: Destructor for the thread-safe SurfaceFactoryCacheThreaded. Declared override and defaulted; releases resources and allows polymorphic deletion.
requirements: Do not use the object after the destructor has run.
Ensure no other threads are accessing the cache at destruction time.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::PreserveQuads
functions.description: Enable or disable quad preservation for quad-based subdivision. When enabled, tessellation attempts to preserve quads in the facet output. Returns the Options object to allow chaining.
requirements: If quad preservation is enabled (on == true), the facet size must be 4 (use SetFacetSize(4)).
May be called any time during Options setup before constructing Tessellation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::PreserveQuads
functions.description: Enable or disable quad preservation for quad-based subdivision. When enabled, tessellation attempts to preserve quads in the facet output. Returns the Options object to allow chaining.
requirements: If quad preservation is enabled (on == true), the facet size must be 4 (use SetFacetSize(4)).
May be called any time during Options setup before constructing Tessellation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::PreserveQuads
functions.description: Enable or disable quad preservation for quad-based subdivision. When enabled, tessellation attempts to preserve quads in the facet output. Returns the Options object to allow chaining.
requirements: If quad preservation is enabled (on == true), the facet size must be 4 (use SetFacetSize(4)).
May be called any time during Options setup before constructing Tessellation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::SetFacetSize
functions.description: Specify the number of indices per facet (triangle or quad facets). Returns the Options object to allow chaining.
requirements: numIndices must be 3 or 4.
If PreserveQuads(true) is used, numIndices must be 4.
Call before constructing Tessellation so downstream facet buffers can be sized correctly.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::SetFacetStride
functions.description: Set the number of elements between successive facet tuples in the output index array. Defaults to the facet size if not set. Returns the Options object to allow chaining.
requirements: stride must be large enough to hold a single facet tuple (i.e., >= GetFacetSize()).
Call before constructing Tessellation so facet output buffers can be prepared.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::SetCoordStride
functions.description: Set the number of elements between successive (u,v) coordinate pairs in the output coordinate array. Default is 2. Returns the Options object to allow chaining.
requirements: stride must be at least 2 to store a (u,v) pair and consistent with how the caller will write/read coordinates.
Call before constructing Tessellation so coordinate output buffers can be prepared.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::GetFacetSize
functions.description: Get the currently configured number of indices per facet (3 for triangles or 4 for quads).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::GetFacetStride
functions.description: Get the stride (in ints) between successive facet tuples in the facet index array.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options::GetCoordStride
functions.description: Get the stride (in scalars) between successive (u,v) coordinate pairs in the coordinate array.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Tessellation
functions.signature: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Tessellation(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Parameterization const & p, int uniformRate, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options const & options = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options())
functions.description: Construct a Tessellation with a single uniform tessellation rate for a face parameterization. Options control facet/coord layout and behavior.
requirements: p must be a valid Parameterization of a face.
uniformRate must be a non-zero integer (positive; zero/negative considered invalid by docs).
options should be configured consistently (e.g., PreserveQuads requires facet size 4; strides should match caller’s buffers).
Constructors can produce an invalid instance if arguments are invalid; callers should check IsValid() before use.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Tessellation
functions.signature: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Tessellation(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Parameterization const & p, int numRates, int const rates[], OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options const & options = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::Options())
functions.description: Construct a Tessellation with multiple tessellation rates for non-uniform tessellation. The array can specify outer edge rates and optional inner rates as described in the documentation. Options control facet/coord layout and behavior.
requirements: p must be a valid Parameterization of a face.
rates must point to an array of non-zero integer tessellation rates.

numRates must match one of the accepted patterns: 1 (single inner rate), N (outer edge rates), N+1 (outer rates plus inner), and for quads only: 2 (two inner rates, outer inferred) or N+2 (outer rates plus two inner).
Edge association: rates[0] corresponds to the edge between vertices 0 and 1; subsequent edges follow increasing vertex indices.
Constructors can produce an invalid instance if arguments are invalid; callers should check IsValid() before use.
options should be configured consistently (e.g., facet size/strides).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::IsValid
functions.description: Indicate whether the Tessellation instance was successfully initialized and can be used.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::~Tessellation
functions.description: Destructor for Tessellation. Releases any resources owned by the tessellation instance.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetParameterization
functions.description: Return the Parameterization associated with this Tessellation (by value).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetFaceSize
functions.description: Return the number of vertices (face size) of the parameterized face.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetRates
functions.description: Copy the tessellation rates associated with this tessellation into the provided array and return the number of rates written.
requirements: rates must point to a writable array large enough to hold all rates returned for the face (count depends on face type and whether inner rates are present: 1, N, N+1, or for quads 2 or N+2).
Callers should use the return value to know how many entries were written.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::IsUniform
functions.description: Return true if the tessellation pattern is uniform (single rate).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetNumCoords
functions.description: Return the total number of parametric coordinates (u,v pairs) in the tessellation pattern (boundary + interior).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetCoordStride
functions.description: Return the stride, in scalar elements, between successive (u,v) coordinate pairs when writing coordinates.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetNumBoundaryCoords
functions.description: Return the number of boundary coordinates in the tessellation pattern.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetNumInteriorCoords
functions.description: Return the number of interior coordinates in the tessellation pattern.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetNumEdgeCoords
functions.description: Return the number of coordinates along a given edge (excluding the edge’s end vertices).
requirements: edge must be a valid edge index in [0, GetFaceSize()).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetCoords
functions.description: Write all tessellation coordinates (boundary first, then interior) into coordTuples and return the number of coordinates written.
requirements: REAL must be a floating-point type suitable for (u,v) pairs (e.g., float or double).
coordTuples must point to writable storage for at least GetNumCoords() * GetCoordStride() scalar elements.
Coordinates are written with stride GetCoordStride().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetBoundaryCoords
functions.description: Write boundary coordinates into coordTuples and return the number of boundary coordinates written.
requirements: REAL must be a floating-point type suitable for (u,v) pairs.
coordTuples must point to writable storage for at least GetNumBoundaryCoords() * GetCoordStride() scalar elements.
Coordinates are written with stride GetCoordStride().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetInteriorCoords
functions.description: Write interior coordinates into coordTuples and return the number of interior coordinates written.
requirements: REAL must be a floating-point type suitable for (u,v) pairs.
coordTuples must point to writable storage for at least GetNumInteriorCoords() * GetCoordStride() scalar elements.
Coordinates are written with stride GetCoordStride().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetVertexCoord
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
int OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetVertexCoord(int vertex, REAL coordTuples[]) const

requirements: vertex must be a valid vertex index in [0, GetFaceSize()).
coordTuples must point to writable storage for at least GetCoordStride() scalar elements (at least 2 for u and v).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetEdgeCoords
functions.signature:

int OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetEdgeCoords(int edge, REAL coordTuples[]) const

functions.description: Return the number of facets (triangles/quads) in the tessellation pattern.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetFacetStride
functions.description: Return the stride, in ints, between successive facet tuples in the facet index array.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::GetFacets
functions.description: Write all facet index tuples into facetTuples and return the number of facets written. Each facet tuple has size GetFacetSize(); triangles may be indicated in quad-sized facets by a negative index in the 4th slot.
requirements: facetTuples must point to writable storage for at least GetNumFacets() * GetFacetStride() integers.
Caller must respect the facet size returned by GetFacetSize(); if size 4, a negative 4th index indicates a triangle.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::TransformFacetCoordIndices
functions.description: Apply a common offset to all coordinate indices in the facet array.
requirements: facetTuples must reference facet indices produced for this Tessellation and be sized for GetNumFacets() * GetFacetStride().
Apply transformations while the distinction between boundary and interior indices remains the original one (first N boundary, remaining interior).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::TransformFacetCoordIndices
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::TransformFacetCoordIndices(int facetTuples[], int const boundaryIndices[], int interiorOffset)
functions.description: Remap boundary coordinate indices using boundaryIndices while applying a uniform offset to interior indices.
requirements: facetTuples must reference facet indices produced for this Tessellation and be sized for GetNumFacets() * GetFacetStride().
boundaryIndices must provide a new index for each boundary coordinate (length == GetNumBoundaryCoords()).
interiorOffset is applied to all interior coord indices.
Boundary and interior indices must be transformed together while boundary indices are still < GetNumBoundaryCoords() and interior indices >= GetNumBoundaryCoords().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::TransformFacetCoordIndices
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::Tessellation::TransformFacetCoordIndices(int facetTuples[], int const boundaryIndices[], int const interiorIndices[])
functions.description: Remap all facet coordinate indices using explicit new indices for boundary and interior coordinates.
requirements: facetTuples must reference facet indices produced for this Tessellation and be sized for GetNumFacets() * GetFacetStride().
boundaryIndices must provide a new index for each boundary coordinate (length == GetNumBoundaryCoords()).
interiorIndices must provide a new index for each interior coordinate (length == GetNumInteriorCoords()).
Boundary and interior indices must be transformed together while the Tessellation can still distinguish them (boundary index < GetNumBoundaryCoords(), interior index >= GetNumBoundaryCoords()).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::Initialize
functions.description: Begins the specification of a vertex neighborhood by declaring the number of incident faces. Must be called before setting topology, face sizes, or sharpness, and followed by Finalize(). Returns false on failure (e.g., invalid inputs or limits exceeded).
requirements: Must be called before any other specification methods and before Finalize().
numIncidentFaces must be within library limits for valence (per Bfr::Limits; typically fits within 16 bits).
numIncidentFaces should be non-negative (negative values are invalid).
On failure, the instance may be marked invalid; callers should check the return value or IsValid().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::Finalize
functions.description: Ends the specification of a vertex neighborhood. Performs validation and final setup. Returns false if the specification is invalid (e.g., counts/sizes exceed limits or inputs are inconsistent).
requirements: Must be called after a successful Initialize() and after all desired assignments (manifold/boundary flags, face sizes, sharpness).
If any values exceed library limits (per Bfr::Limits), finalization will fail.
Callers should check the return value or IsValid() to confirm success.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::IsValid
functions.description: Reports whether the descriptor is currently valid. Useful after Initialize() and Finalize() or after assignments that may invalidate the descriptor.
requirements: None beyond a properly constructed VertexDescriptor instance.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetManifold
functions.description: Declares whether the vertex neighborhood is manifold (ordered and consistently oriented). When true, factories may assume ordered incident faces/edges and non-degenerate edges for efficiency.
requirements: Should be called between Initialize() and Finalize().
Only set true if all incident faces are ordered counter-clockwise, consistently oriented, and all incident edges are non-degenerate.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetBoundary
functions.description: Declares whether the vertex lies on a boundary. Affects interpretation of incident edges (boundary vertices have one more incident edge than faces in the ordered sequence).
requirements: Should be called between Initialize() and Finalize().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetIncidentFaceSize
functions.description: Assigns the size (number of vertices) of a specific incident face by index in the incident-face sequence.
requirements: Must be called between Initialize() and Finalize().
faceIndex must refer to a valid incident face: 0 <= faceIndex < numIncidentFaces.
faceSize must be within library limits for face size (per Bfr::Limits; typically fits within 16 bits).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::ClearIncidentFaceSizes
functions.description: Clears any previously assigned incident face sizes, reverting to the unassigned state.
requirements: Should be called between Initialize() and Finalize() if used to alter the specification.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetVertexSharpness
functions.description: Assigns the sharpness value to the vertex. Used to encode vertex creasing behavior.
requirements: Should be called between Initialize() and Finalize().
sharpness is a floating-point value; valid range is not specified in this header (no explicit constraints given).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::ClearVertexSharpness
functions.description: Clears any previously assigned vertex sharpness (sets to 0).
requirements: Should be called between Initialize() and Finalize() if used to alter the specification.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetManifoldEdgeSharpness
functions.description: For manifold vertices only, assigns a sharpness value to an edge in the ordered sequence around the vertex. For boundary vertices, the ordered edge sequence has one more edge than faces.
requirements: The vertex must be declared manifold via SetManifold(true) before using this method.
Must be called between Initialize() and Finalize().
For interior manifold vertices: 0 <= edgeIndex < numIncidentFaces.
For boundary manifold vertices: 0 <= edgeIndex <= numIncidentFaces (edges count equals faces + 1).
edgeSharpness is a floating-point value; valid range is not specified in this header.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetIncidentFaceEdgeSharpness
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::SetIncidentFaceEdgeSharpness(int faceIndex, float leadingEdgeSharp, float trailingEdgeSharp)
functions.description: Assigns sharpness values to the two edges of an incident face that meet at the vertex: the leading edge (following the vertex in face order) and the trailing edge (preceding the vertex). Works for manifold and non-manifold cases.
requirements: Must be called between Initialize() and Finalize().
faceIndex must refer to a valid incident face: 0 <= faceIndex < numIncidentFaces.
leadingEdgeSharp and trailingEdgeSharp are floating-point values; valid ranges are not specified in this header.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::ClearEdgeSharpness
functions.description: Clears any previously assigned incident-edge sharpness values.
requirements: Should be called between Initialize() and Finalize() if used to alter the specification.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::IsManifold
functions.description: Returns whether the vertex neighborhood is marked as manifold (ordered, consistently oriented, non-degenerate edges).
requirements: None; may be called at any time to inspect current state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::IsBoundary
functions.description: Returns whether the vertex neighborhood is marked as being on a boundary.
requirements: None; may be called at any time to inspect current state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::HasIncidentFaceSizes
functions.description: Reports whether incident face sizes have been assigned.
requirements: None; may be called at any time to inspect current state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::GetIncidentFaceSize
functions.description: Returns the size (number of vertices) of the specified incident face. Before Finalize(), returns the raw assigned size. After Finalize(), returns the finalized difference-based value.
requirements: faceIndex must refer to a valid incident face: 0 <= faceIndex < numIncidentFaces.
Should only be called if incident face sizes were assigned or are otherwise valid for the descriptor.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::HasVertexSharpness
functions.description: Returns true if a positive vertex sharpness has been assigned (sharpness > 0.0f).
requirements: None; may be called at any time to inspect current state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::GetVertexSharpness
functions.description: Returns the assigned vertex sharpness value (0.0f if cleared).
requirements: None; may be called at any time to inspect current state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::HasEdgeSharpness
functions.description: Reports whether any incident-edge sharpness has been assigned.
requirements: None; may be called at any time to inspect current state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::GetManifoldEdgeSharpness
functions.description: Returns the sharpness assigned to a manifold edge by its index in the ordered sequence. On boundary vertices, the last edge is treated specially in indexing.
requirements: Should only be used when the vertex is marked manifold via SetManifold(true).
edgeIndex must be within the valid ordered sequence range: for interior manifold vertices, 0 <= edgeIndex < numIncidentFaces; for boundary manifold vertices, 0 <= edgeIndex <= numIncidentFaces.
Edge sharpness should have been assigned previously (via SetManifoldEdgeSharpness or SetIncidentFaceEdgeSharpness) before calling this accessor.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::GetIncidentFaceEdgeSharpness
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Bfr::VertexDescriptor::GetIncidentFaceEdgeSharpness(int faceIndex, float * leadingEdgeSharp, float * trailingEdgeSharp) const
functions.description: Retrieves the sharpness values of the two edges of an incident face meeting at the vertex: leading (following) and trailing (preceding) edges, relative to the vertex in the face order.
requirements: faceIndex must refer to a valid incident face: 0 <= faceIndex < numIncidentFaces.
leadingEdgeSharp and trailingEdgeSharp pointers must be non-null.
Edge sharpness should have been assigned previously before calling this accessor.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::SetErrorCallback
functions.description: Registers the global error callback for Far. The callback is invoked by the library when an error occurs; by default errors are printed using printf. Not thread-safe to set; typically called during initialization to route error reporting. The provided callback must match ErrorCallbackFunc (void(*)(ErrorType, const char*)) and is expected to remain valid while in use. Further behavioral details (ownership, nullability, threading of invocations) are not specified in this header and are unknown.
requirements: Callers must pass a function pointer matching the exact type OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::ErrorCallbackFunc (i.e., void (*)(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::ErrorType, const char *)).
This function is not thread-safe: callers must avoid concurrent calls and should serialize access when setting/replacing the callback.
The provided function pointer must remain valid for as long as the library may issue error callbacks (no lifetime shorter than its potential use).
The callback must not attempt to modify the const char* message it receives.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::SetWarningCallback
functions.description: Registers the global warning callback for Far. The callback is invoked by the library to report warnings; by default warnings are printed using printf. Not thread-safe to set; typically called during initialization to route warning reporting. The provided callback must match WarningCallbackFunc (void(*)(const char*)) and is expected to remain valid while in use. Further behavioral details (ownership, nullability, threading of invocations) are not specified in this header and are unknown.
requirements: Callers must pass a function pointer matching the exact type OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::WarningCallbackFunc (i.e., void (*)(const char *)).
This function is not thread-safe: callers must avoid concurrent calls and should serialize access when setting/replacing the callback.
The provided function pointer must remain valid for as long as the library may issue warning callbacks (no lifetime shorter than its potential use).
The callback must not attempt to modify the const char* message it receives.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::PatchDescriptor
functions.description: Default constructor. Initializes the descriptor with type NON_PATCH (undefined). Use when you intend to assign or set a specific patch type later.
requirements: None beyond standard object construction; resulting descriptor has type NON_PATCH

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::PatchDescriptor
functions.description: Constructs a descriptor from a raw integer type value stored internally. GetType() will reinterpret this value as PatchDescriptor::Type. Prefer passing a valid PatchDescriptor::Type constant.
requirements: Parameter type should correspond to a valid OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::Type value; using other values may result in undefined/unsupported behavior in queries (e.g., -1 from GetNumControlVertices).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::PatchDescriptor
functions.description: Copy constructor. Duplicates the patch type from another descriptor.
requirements: Source descriptor d must be a valid initialized object.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::operator=
functions.description: Assignment operator. Copies the patch type from another descriptor and returns *this.
requirements: Right-hand operand d must be a valid initialized PatchDescriptor.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetType
functions.description: Returns the current patch type for this descriptor.
requirements: Descriptor must have been constructed; no additional requirements.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::IsAdaptive
functions.description: Returns true if the given patch type is adaptive (non-linear). Implementation considers types greater than TRIANGLES adaptive.
requirements: Argument type should be a valid PatchDescriptor::Type value.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::IsAdaptive
functions.description: Returns true if this descriptor’s type is adaptive (non-linear).
requirements: Descriptor should hold a valid patch type for meaningful results.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetNumControlVertices
functions.description: Returns the number of control vertices expected for a patch of the given type. Known sizes include: REGULAR=16, LOOP=12, QUADS=4, GREGORY/GREGORY_BOUNDARY=4, GREGORY_BASIS=20, GREGORY_TRIANGLE=18, TRIANGLES=3, LINES=2, POINTS=1. Returns -1 for NON_PATCH/unsupported types.
requirements: Argument t should be one of the defined PatchDescriptor::Type enum values.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetNumControlVertices
functions.description: Returns the number of control vertices expected for this descriptor’s type. Delegates to the static GetNumControlVertices(Type).
requirements: Descriptor should hold a valid patch type for meaningful results; otherwise may return -1.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetNumFVarControlVertices
functions.description: Deprecated alias of GetNumControlVertices(Type). Returns the number of face-varying control vertices expected for the given patch type; implementation forwards to GetNumControlVertices.
requirements: Argument t should be one of the defined PatchDescriptor::Type enum values.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetNumFVarControlVertices
functions.description: Deprecated. Returns the number of face-varying control vertices for this descriptor’s type; implementation delegates to GetNumControlVertices().
requirements: Descriptor should hold a valid patch type for meaningful results; otherwise may return -1.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetRegularPatchSize
functions.description: Returns the number of control vertices for regular B-spline (REGULAR) patches: 16.
requirements: None.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetGregoryPatchSize
functions.description: Returns the number of control vertices for Gregory and Gregory Boundary patches: 4 (table size).
requirements: None.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetGregoryBasisPatchSize
functions.description: Returns the number of control vertices for a Gregory patch basis: 20.
requirements: None.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::GetAdaptivePatchDescriptors
functions.description: Returns a ConstArray of all legal patch descriptors for the given adaptive subdivision scheme. Intended for enumerating supported adaptive patch types for a scheme.
requirements: Parameter type must be a valid OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::SchemeType.
Returned ConstArray is read-only; attempts to modify its elements are not allowed.
Lifetime/ownership semantics of the returned view are unknown from this header; callers should not assume it outlives the underlying library context (details unknown).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::operator<
functions.description: Provides an ordering relation based on the underlying patch type integral value. Useful for sorting or associative containers.
requirements: None; comparison is well-defined for any two PatchDescriptor instances.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::operator==
functions.description: Equality operator. Returns true when both descriptors have the same patch type.
requirements: None; equality is based solely on stored type value.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchDescriptor::print
functions.description: Debug helper that prints the descriptor (implementation not shown). Intended for diagnostic output.
requirements: Side effects include writing to a debug output stream; exact destination and format are unknown.
No parameters; descriptor must be initialized.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Set
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Set(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::Index faceid, short u, short v, unsigned short depth, bool nonquad, unsigned short boundary, unsigned short transition, bool regular = false)
functions.description: Initialize the packed patch-parameter bitfields for a refined face. Encodes the coarse face id, param-space origin (u,v) for the first corner, subdivision level, root-face topology (quad vs non-quad), boundary mask, transition-edge mask, and regularity flag. Typical use: call once when constructing patch tables so subsequent query/transform helpers (Get*, Normalize/Unnormalize, etc.) operate correctly.
requirements: faceid must fit in 28 bits; values beyond 28 bits are truncated by packing.
u must fit in 10 bits (0..1023). Intended to represent the integer param offset at the first patch corner; typically 0 <= u < (1 << depth).
v must fit in 10 bits (0..1023). Intended to represent the integer param offset at the first patch corner; typically 0 <= v < (1 << depth).
depth must fit in 4 bits (0..15).
If nonquad is true, depth must be >= 1 to avoid undefined behavior in GetParamFraction (which shifts by depth - 1).
boundary must fit in 5 bits (0..31). Encodes boundary edges (and verts for tris).
transition must fit in 4 bits (0..15). Encodes transition edges.
regular is a boolean flag; nonzero is treated as true.
Caller is responsible for providing consistent values; no range checking is performed and out-of-range inputs will be silently truncated by bit packing.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Clear
functions.description: Reset both internal packed fields to zero, clearing all encoded parameters. Use to reinitialize a PatchParam before calling Set.
requirements: No arguments. Safe to call at any time on a PatchParam instance.
All previously encoded values are lost after this call.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetFaceId
functions.description: Return the encoded coarse face id associated with this patch.
requirements: PatchParam must have been initialized (e.g., via Set) to return meaningful data; otherwise returns whatever is encoded in field0 (zero after Clear).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetU
functions.description: Return the encoded u-origin (log2-style integer offset) at the first patch corner.
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.
The returned value is the 10-bit packed value; no validation is performed.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetV
functions.description: Return the encoded v-origin (log2-style integer offset) at the first patch corner.
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.
The returned value is the 10-bit packed value; no validation is performed.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetTransition
functions.description: Return the transition edge bitmask (4-bit) for the patch, identifying edges adjacent to next-level refinement.
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.
Returned value is the 4-bit packed mask; bits beyond the lower 4 are zero due to packing.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetBoundary
functions.description: Return the boundary edge bitmask (5-bit) for the patch, identifying interpolated boundary edges (and vertices for triangles).
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.
Returned value is the 5-bit packed mask; bits beyond the lower 5 are zero due to packing.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::NonQuadRoot
functions.description: Return true if the root (coarse) face for this patch was non-quad, affecting parameterization and fraction calculations.
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetDepth
functions.description: Return the subdivision level (depth) of the patch.
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.
Depth is a 4-bit value (0..15) as encoded.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::GetParamFraction
functions.description: Return the fraction of unit parametric space covered by this patch: 1.0f / (1 << (depth - (nonquad ? 1 : 0))). Used to scale between normalized and packed param spaces.
requirements: PatchParam must contain a valid depth; if NonQuadRoot() is true then GetDepth() must be >= 1 to avoid undefined behavior from shifting by a negative amount.
No arguments; safe to call after Set.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Normalize
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Normalize(REAL & u, REAL & v) const
functions.description: Map a point (u,v) from the patch’s fractional parametric space into a normalized [0..1) patch-local space based on the encoded origin and fraction. Equivalent to: u = u/frac - U0; v = v/frac - V0, where frac = GetParamFraction() and U0,V0 are GetU()/GetV().
requirements: Template parameter REAL must support arithmetic operations with floats and integers (+, -, *, /) and assignment.
u and v must be lvalue references to REAL and will be updated in place.
PatchParam must be initialized; GetParamFraction(), GetU(), and GetV() must be meaningful.
Inputs u and v are expected to be in the patch’s fractional param space (typically [0,1] for unit space scaled by frac); no range checks are performed.
REAL values should be finite; NaN/Inf propagate without checks.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::NormalizeTriangle
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::NormalizeTriangle(REAL & u, REAL & v) const
functions.description: Normalize triangle patch parameters from fractional space to patch-local normalized space, accounting for triangle rotation. If IsTriangleRotated() is true, applies a flipped origin mapping; otherwise defers to Normalize().
requirements: Template parameter REAL must support arithmetic operations with floats and integers (+, -, *, /) and assignment.
u and v must be lvalue references to REAL and will be updated in place.
PatchParam must be initialized; relies on GetParamFraction(), GetDepth(), GetU(), GetV(), and IsTriangleRotated().
Inputs u and v are expected to be in the patch’s fractional param space for triangular schemes; no range checks are performed.
REAL values should be finite; NaN/Inf propagate without checks.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Unnormalize
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::Unnormalize(REAL & u, REAL & v) const
functions.description: Map a point (u,v) from the patch’s normalized local space back to the fractional parametric space. Equivalent to: u = (u + U0) * frac; v = (v + V0) * frac.
requirements: Template parameter REAL must support arithmetic operations with floats and integers (+, -, *, /) and assignment.
u and v must be lvalue references to REAL and will be updated in place.
PatchParam must be initialized; GetParamFraction(), GetU(), and GetV() must be meaningful.
Inputs u and v are expected to be in normalized local space; no range checks are performed.
REAL values should be finite; NaN/Inf propagate without checks.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::UnnormalizeTriangle
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::UnnormalizeTriangle(REAL & u, REAL & v) const
functions.description: Inverse mapping for triangle patches from normalized local space back to fractional parametric space, handling the rotated-triangle case consistently with NormalizeTriangle().
requirements: Template parameter REAL must support arithmetic operations with floats and integers (+, -, *, /) and assignment.
u and v must be lvalue references to REAL and will be updated in place.
PatchParam must be initialized; relies on GetParamFraction(), GetDepth(), GetU(), GetV(), and IsTriangleRotated().
Inputs u and v are expected to be in normalized local space; no range checks are performed.
REAL values should be finite; NaN/Inf propagate without checks.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::IsTriangleRotated
functions.description: Return true if the triangular patch is parametrically rotated 180 degrees in the quad-tree hierarchy. Computed as (GetU() + GetV()) >= (1 << GetDepth()).
requirements: Meaningful only for triangular subdivision schemes; for quads this is not applicable but still returns a boolean based on the encoded values.
PatchParam must be initialized for meaningful results.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchParam::IsRegular
functions.description: Return whether the patch is marked as regular (i.e., refined from a configuration that yields a regular patch).
requirements: PatchParam should be initialized via Set for meaningful results.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchMap::PatchMap
functions.description: Constructs a PatchMap from a given PatchTable. The PatchMap builds an internal quadtree that maps coarse (potentially quadrangulated/Ptex) face indices to sub-patches and enables fast lookup of the patch containing a parametric location. Usage: create once from a valid PatchTable before calling FindPatch. Internal details such as handle extraction and quadtree construction are performed during construction. Further behavioral details beyond this are not documented in this header.
requirements: patchTable must be a valid OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable (as stated by the comments).
No other explicit preconditions are documented; performance characteristics and ownership/lifetime relations to patchTable are unknown from this header.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchMap::FindPatch
functions.signature: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchMap::Handle const * OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchMap::FindPatch(int patchFaceId, double u, double v) const
functions.description: Returns a handle to the sub-patch of the given patch (Ptex) face that contains the local parametric location (u,v). The face index corresponds to Ptex/quadrangulated faces rather than original base-mesh faces. Returns null if the face index is out of bounds for this PatchMap or if the face is a hole/unsupported. Expected usage: construct a PatchMap from a PatchTable, then call FindPatch with a valid patchFaceId and normalized (u,v) in [0,1] to retrieve a patch handle for evaluation or further processing. In debug builds, invalid (u,v) outside [0,1] will trigger an assertion.
requirements: Caller must pass patchFaceId corresponding to a Ptex (potentially quadrangulated) face index supported by this PatchMap; otherwise, the function returns null.
Caller must pass u in [0,1] and v in [0,1]; the function asserts these bounds (debug builds).
Caller must handle a null return value (e.g., when the face is out of bounds or tagged as a hole).
The PatchMap instance must have been successfully constructed from a valid PatchTable before calling this function.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::PatchTable
functions.description: Copy constructor. Creates a new PatchTable that is a copy of the provided source table, duplicating patch arrays, indices, params and related internal state.
requirements: src must refer to a valid PatchTable instance.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::~PatchTable
functions.description: Destructor. Releases resources owned by the PatchTable.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::IsFeatureAdaptive
functions.description: Returns true if patches in this table are of feature-adaptive types (as opposed to uniform).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::GetNumControlVerticesTotal
functions.description: Returns the total number of control vertex indices stored across all patches in the table.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::GetNumPatchesTotal
functions.description: Returns the total number of patches contained in the table, summed across all patch arrays.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::EvaluateBasis
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
void EvaluateBasis(PatchHandle const & handle, REAL u, REAL v,
        REAL wP[], REAL wDu[] = 0, REAL wDv[] = 0,
        REAL wDuu[] = 0, REAL wDuv[] = 0, REAL wDvv[] = 0) const;
functions.description: Evaluates basis function weights for position and up to second derivatives at the (u,v) location within the patch identified by handle, writing weights into the provided arrays.
requirements: handle must be valid and produced by this PatchTable.
u and v should lie within the patch’s normalized parametric domain [0,1].
wP must be non-null and have capacity for the patch’s control vertex count.
wDu, wDv, wDuu, wDuv, wDvv are optional; if non-null, each must have capacity equal to the patch’s control vertex count.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTable::EvaluateBasisVarying
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
void EvaluateBasisVarying(PatchHandle const & handle, REAL u, REAL v,
        REAL wP[], REAL wDu[] = 0, REAL wDv[] = 0,
        REAL wDuu[] = 0, REAL wDuv[] = 0, REAL wDvv[] = 0) const;
functions.description: Evaluates basis function weights for a varying value (and derivatives up to second order) at (u,v) for the patch identified by handle.
requirements: handle must be valid and produced by this PatchTable.
u and v should lie within [0,1].
wP must be non-null and have capacity equal to the varying control count for the patch’s descriptor.
Optional arrays, if non-null, must match that size.

u and v should lie within [0,1].
channel must be in [0, GetNumFVarChannels()).
wP must be non-null and have capacity equal to the face-varying control count for the patch/channel.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Options::GetEndCapType

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Options::SetEndCapType
functions.description: Sets the end-cap basis type used to approximate irregular patches. Accepts one of the EndCapType enum values.
requirements: Parameter e should be one of: ENDCAP_NONE, ENDCAP_BILINEAR_BASIS, ENDCAP_BSPLINE_BASIS, ENDCAP_GREGORY_BASIS, or ENDCAP_LEGACY_GREGORY.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Options::SetMaxIsolationLevel
functions.description: Sets the maximum adaptive feature isolation level used during adaptive refinement when creating a PatchTable.
requirements: Recommended/meaningful range is 0..10 per documentation comment (values are masked to 4 bits internally).
Caller should choose a non-negative level; higher levels increase refinement cost.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Options::SetPatchPrecision
functions.description: Selects the numeric precision for vertex patch stencils based on the REAL template parameter. In this header, explicit specializations exist for float (single) and double (double) precision.
requirements: REAL must be float or double; only these two explicit specializations are defined here.
Call on a valid Options instance before creating a PatchTable to affect generated patch precision.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Options::SetFVarPatchPrecision
functions.description: Selects the numeric precision for face-varying patch stencils based on the REAL template parameter. Explicit specializations are provided for float and double.
requirements: REAL must be float or double; only these two explicit specializations are defined here.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Options::GetRefineAdaptiveOptions
functions.description: Constructs and returns a TopologyRefiner::AdaptiveOptions object configured to match the current Options for end-cap/patch handling and face-varying considerations. Useful for ensuring the refiner’s adaptive settings are consistent with PatchTable generation options.
requirements: Options object must be valid/initialized.
Returned AdaptiveOptions reflects: maxIsolationLevel, useInfSharpPatch, useSingleCreasePatch, and considerFVarChannels if face-varying tables are enabled and legacy linear fvar patches are disabled.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PatchTableFactory::Create
functions.description: Creates a new PatchTable from the supplied TopologyRefiner using the given Options. Works with both adaptively and uniformly refined refiners. Optionally restricts patch generation to a subset of base faces (selectedFaces). Returns a heap-allocated PatchTable pointer.
requirements: refiner must describe a topology that has been refined (either adaptively or uniformly) appropriately for the intended patch generation.
When using adaptive refinement with selectedFaces, the set must be a subset of the faces that were adaptively refined in the provided TopologyRefiner; otherwise results are undefined.
selectedFaces indices refer to base-level faces.
Behavior of index spaces differs for uniform mode: vertex/varying patches may reference base and last levels; face-varying patches reference only the last level.
Caller must handle potential null on failure (not specified here) and manage the lifetime of the returned PatchTable pointer (ownership implied but not explicitly documented).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal::Interpolate
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
template <class T, class U>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal<REAL>::Interpolate(int level, T const& src, U& dst) const
functions.description: Interpolates vertex (vertex-rate) primvar data from level-1 to the specified level using the subdivision scheme’s interpolation masks. Writes results for all child vertices at that level into dst. Intended for generic primvar buffers implementing Clear() and AddWithWeight(...).
requirements: level must be > 0 and <= number of available refinement levels in the associated TopologyRefiner (asserted).
dst must be sized to hold all refined vertices at the target level: at least GetTopologyRefiner().GetLevel(level).GetNumVertices() elements.
src must provide indexed access via operator[](int) returning a readable primvar value.
dst must provide: operator[](int) returning a writable element that supports Clear() and AddWithWeight(value, weight).
Interpolation is scheme-dependent (Catmark/Loop/Bilinear); caller must ensure the source data corresponds to the parent level (level-1).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal::InterpolateVarying
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
template <class T, class U>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal<REAL>::InterpolateVarying(int level, T const& src, U& dst) const
functions.description: Interpolates varying-rate primvar data (linearly over faces/edges, copy at vertices) from level-1 to the specified level. Useful for primvars that do not need time-varying recomputation beyond a single pass.
requirements: level must be > 0 and <= number of available refinement levels in the associated TopologyRefiner (asserted).
dst must be sized to hold all refined vertices at the target level: at least GetTopologyRefiner().GetLevel(level).GetNumVertices() elements.
src must provide operator[](int) for read access; dst must provide operator[](int) with Clear() and AddWithWeight(...).
Caller must supply source data corresponding to the parent level (level-1).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal::InterpolateFaceUniform
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
template <class T, class U>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal<REAL>::InterpolateFaceUniform(int level, T const& src, U& dst) const
functions.description: Propagates uniform (per-face) primvar data from parent faces to child faces at the specified level by copying the parent face’s value to each child face. Useful for face-rate attributes such as material IDs.
requirements: level must be > 0 and <= number of available refinement levels in the associated TopologyRefiner (asserted).
dst must be sized to hold all refined faces at the target level: at least GetTopologyRefiner().GetLevel(level).GetNumFaces() elements.
src must provide operator[](int) to read per-face values from the parent level; dst must provide operator[](int) to write per-face values for the child level.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal::InterpolateFaceVarying
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
template <class T, class U>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal<REAL>::InterpolateFaceVarying(int level, T const& src, U& dst, int channel = 0) const
functions.description: Interpolates face-varying primvar data for the specified channel from level-1 to the specified level. Handles cases where face-varying topology may or may not match the vertex topology, applying the appropriate masks per the subdivision scheme.
requirements: level must be > 0 and <= number of available refinement levels in the associated TopologyRefiner (asserted).
channel must refer to an existing and initialized face-varying channel in the refiner.
dst must be sized to hold all refined face-varying values at the target level: at least GetTopologyRefiner().GetLevel(level).GetNumFVarValues(channel).
src must provide operator[](int) for read access to face-varying values; dst must provide operator[](int) with Clear() and AddWithWeight(...).
Caller must supply source data for the parent level’s face-varying values.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal::Limit
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
template <class T, class U>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal<REAL>::Limit(T const& src, U& dstPos) const
functions.description: Evaluates vertex-rate primvar data at the subdivision limit positions for the last refinement level and writes the limit positions to dstPos. Uses scheme-specific limit masks. This overload computes only positions.
requirements: The last refinement level must include full topology (getNumVertexEdgesTotal() > 0); otherwise an error is reported and the function returns without computation.
src must contain previously interpolated vertex-rate data for the last refinement level (indices correspond to the last level’s vertices).
dstPos must be sized to the number of vertices at the last refinement level: GetTopologyRefiner().GetLevel(GetTopologyRefiner().GetMaxLevel()).GetNumVertices().
dstPos elements must support Clear() and AddWithWeight(value, weight).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal::LimitFaceVarying
functions.signature:
template <typename REAL>
template <class T, class U>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::PrimvarRefinerReal<REAL>::LimitFaceVarying(T const& src, U& dst, int channel = 0) const
functions.description: Evaluates face-varying primvar data at the subdivision limit for the specified channel on the last refinement level and writes the limit values to dst. Applies scheme-specific limit masks and handles both matching and split (sibling) face-varying topologies.
requirements: The last refinement level must include full topology (getNumVertexEdgesTotal() > 0); otherwise an error is reported and the function returns without computation.
channel must refer to an existing and initialized face-varying channel in the refiner.
src must contain face-varying data for the last refinement level; indices are face-varying value indices, not vertex indices.
dst must be sized to hold all face-varying values at the last level: GetTopologyRefiner().GetLevel(GetTopologyRefiner().GetMaxLevel()).GetNumFVarValues(channel).
dst elements must support Clear() and AddWithWeight(value, weight).
