functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::StencilTableFactoryReal::Create
functions.signature: static StencilTableReal<REAL> const * Create(TopologyRefiner const & refiner, Options options = Options());
functions.description: Create a StencilTableReal for a given TopologyRefiner using the specified Options. Intended to build primvar stencils (vertex, varying, or face-varying) for vertices that have already been generated by uniform or adaptive refinement of the refiner. Typical usage: refine the topology (RefineUniform or RefineAdaptive), then call Create with the desired interpolation mode and options to obtain a stencil table for evaluation.
requirements: refiner must have been refined uniformly or adaptively prior to this call; only vertices already refined in refiner will receive stencils
options.interpolationMode selects vertex, varying, or face-varying stencils
If options.generateOffsets is true, the optional offsets field will be populated
If options.generateControlVerts is true, control-vertex stencils will be generated
If options.generateIntermediateLevels is false, only highest-level vertices are generated; otherwise all levels up to options.maxLevel are generated
If options.factorizeIntermediateLevels is true, intermediate stencils are accumulated from control vertices; otherwise from previous level stencils
For face-varying mode, options.fvarChannel selects the face-varying channel
Caller must treat the returned pointer as a valid, const-owned table (ownership and lifetime management are unknown from this header)

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::StencilTableFactoryReal::Create
functions.signature: static StencilTableReal<REAL> const * Create(int numTables, StencilTableReal<REAL> const ** tables);
functions.description: Create a new StencilTableReal by concatenating multiple existing stencil tables. This is a utility to merge compatible stencil tables without reindexing their control vertices.
requirements: All input tables must point to the same set of supporting control vertices; no re-indexing is performed
GetNumControlVertices() must return the same value for all input tables
tables must reference numTables valid StencilTableReal<REAL> instances; null entries are invalid
Caller must ensure the lifetime of input tables outlives the concatenation process (ownership/lifetime of the returned table is unknown from this header)

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::StencilTableFactoryReal::AppendLocalPointStencilTable
functions.signature: static StencilTableReal<REAL> const * AppendLocalPointStencilTable(TopologyRefiner const &refiner, StencilTableReal<REAL> const *baseStencilTable, StencilTableReal<REAL> const *localPointStencilTable, bool factorize = true);
functions.description: Splice local point stencils into an existing base stencil table. Merges stencils for change-of-basis patch points with the stencils for refined vertices, optionally factorizing endcap stencils to reference control vertices directly.
requirements: refiner is the topology context used to build the base/local stencil tables
baseStencilTable should contain stencils for refined vertices

functions.description: Splice local point face-varying stencils into a base stencil table for a specified face-varying channel. Optionally factorizes endcap stencils to depend directly on control vertices.
requirements: refiner must match the topology for which the stencil tables were generated
baseStencilTable should contain stencils for refined vertices (face-varying)
localPointStencilTable should contain compatible local point face-varying stencils

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::LimitStencilTableFactoryReal::Create
functions.signature: static LimitStencilTableReal<REAL> const * Create(TopologyRefiner const & refiner, LocationArrayVec const & locationArrays, StencilTableReal<REAL> const * cvStencils = 0, PatchTable const * patchTable = 0, Options options = Options());
functions.description: Create a LimitStencilTableReal that evaluates the limit surface at specified locations. Locations are given as ptex face indices with arrays of normalized (s,t) coordinates. The generated stencils are bilinear if the surface was refined uniformly or bicubic for feature-adaptive isolation. Optionally, provide compatible control/refined-vertex stencil tables and patch tables to avoid redundant construction.
requirements: refiner must have been refined uniformly or adaptively prior to this call
locationArrays contains one or more LocationArray entries; for each entry, numLocations must match the length of the s and t arrays, and s/t pointers must be valid when numLocations > 0
If cvStencils is provided, it must contain stencils for all control points and all refined points; any stencils for local patch points must match the provided or internally generated PatchTable
If patchTable is provided, it must match the cvStencils if cvStencils is also provided
options.interpolationMode selects vertex, varying, or face-varying stencils; options.generate1stDerivatives and options.generate2ndDerivatives control derivative weight generation
For face-varying mode, options.fvarChannel selects the channel
All pointer arguments, if non-null, must be valid

options fields behave as in the templated factory (interpolation mode, offsets, control verts, intermediate levels, factorization, maxLevel, fvarChannel)
Returned pointer is const; ownership/lifetime are not specified in this header

tables must reference numTables valid StencilTable instances; null entries are invalid

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::LimitStencilTableFactory::Create
functions.signature: static LimitStencilTable const * Create(TopologyRefiner const & refiner, LocationArrayVec const & locationArrays, StencilTable const * cvStencils = 0, PatchTable const * patchTable = 0, Options options = Options());
functions.description: Wrapper that creates a LimitStencilTable (float) using LimitStencilTableFactoryReal<float>. Evaluates the limit surface at specified locations, optionally generating derivative weights and leveraging provided control/refined-vertex stencil and patch tables.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor::TopologyDescriptor
functions.description: Default constructor for Far::TopologyDescriptor. Initializes a descriptor object that the caller is expected to populate with raw mesh topology (vertices, faces, indices, creases, corners, holes, face-varying channels) before passing it to a TopologyRefinerFactory to build a TopologyRefiner. Specific member default values are not visible here; consult the implementation or set all fields explicitly before use.
requirements: Constructed object must be fully and consistently populated before being used with TopologyRefinerFactory functions.
All pointer members must either be null when their corresponding count is zero or point to valid arrays of at least the specified lengths (inferred from the struct layout).

Indices supplied via vertIndicesPerFace, creaseVertexIndexPairs, cornerVertexIndices, and FVarChannel::valueIndices must reference valid vertices in the described topology (inferred from typical usage).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor::FVarChannel::FVarChannel
functions.description: Default constructor for a face-varying data channel within TopologyDescriptor. Initializes numValues to 0 and valueIndices to null. Intended to be configured by the caller to describe a single face-varying channel whose value indices are specified per face-vertex.
requirements: After construction, set numValues and valueIndices before using the channel in a TopologyDescriptor.
When numValues > 0, valueIndices must point to an array containing one entry for every vertex of every face (i.e., per face-vertex) as implied by the comments in the header.
valueIndices entries should be valid indices into the channel’s value table of size numValues (inferred from naming and common OpenSubdiv patterns).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor>::resizeComponentTopology
functions.description: Factory specialization hook that sizes the topology storage in a TopologyRefiner based on the provided TopologyDescriptor (e.g., number of vertices, faces, and related counts). Returns true on success. Used internally by TopologyRefinerFactory during refiner construction.
requirements: refiner must be a valid TopologyRefiner instance in a state where its base topology can be resized (inferred from name and typical factory workflow).
desc must contain consistent counts (e.g., numVertices, numFaces) and valid pointers when counts are non-zero.
Should be called before assigning component topology and tags within the factory build process (inferred from naming order).
Caller should check the boolean return value to handle failure.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor>::assignComponentTopology
functions.description: Factory specialization hook that assigns base-level component topology (e.g., face-vertex incidence, crease and corner data, holes) from a TopologyDescriptor into a TopologyRefiner after storage has been sized. Returns true on success. Used internally by TopologyRefinerFactory.
requirements: refiner must have been sized appropriately via resizeComponentTopology prior to this call (inferred from typical sequence).

desc arrays must be valid and match the declared counts: numVertsPerFace must have length numFaces; vertIndicesPerFace must have sum(numVertsPerFace) entries; crease/corner/hole arrays must match their respective counts.
Indices provided in desc must be within [0, numVertices-1] (inferred from meaning of indices).
Caller should check the boolean return value to detect and handle assignment failures.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor>::assignComponentTags
functions.description: Factory specialization hook that applies per-component tags (e.g., crease weights, corner weights, holes, handedness) from a TopologyDescriptor to the TopologyRefiner. Returns true on success. Used internally as part of the factory build pipeline.
requirements: refiner must already have base component topology assigned (inferred from workflow).
desc’s creaseWeights and cornerWeights arrays must contain exactly numCreases and numCorners entries, respectively, when those counts are non-zero.
If isLeftHanded is set, the topology may be interpreted accordingly by the factory; callers should ensure the flag reflects the input winding (inferred from member name and comment).
Caller should check the boolean return value to handle tagging failures.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor>::assignFaceVaryingTopology
functions.description: Factory specialization hook that assigns face-varying (FVar) topology channels from the TopologyDescriptor into the TopologyRefiner. Returns true on success. Used internally when the descriptor advertises FVar channels.
requirements: desc.numFVarChannels must be non-negative; when greater than zero, desc.fvarChannels must point to an array of length numFVarChannels.
Each FVarChannel must have numValues set and valueIndices populated with one index per face-vertex as noted in the header comment.
refiner must be in a state ready to accept FVar topology assignment (typically after base component topology is assigned; inferred from workflow).
Caller should check the boolean return value to handle failure.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor>::reportInvalidTopology
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor>::reportInvalidTopology(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyError errCode, char const * msg, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyDescriptor const & desc)

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetNumVertices
functions.description: Returns the number of vertices in this topology level. Typically used to bounds-check vertex indices and to size per-vertex data for this level.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetNumEdges
functions.description: Returns the number of edges in this topology level. Useful for validating edge indices and iterating edges.

functions.description: Returns the two vertex indices that form edge e as a fixed-size view.

The returned array view refers to internal storage; lifetime is tied to the owning TopologyRefiner and refinement state.
The TopologyLevel must be initialized by a TopologyRefiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetEdgeFaces
functions.description: Returns a view of the faces incident to edge e (one for boundary edges, typically two for interior edges).
requirements: e must be a valid edge index: 0 <= e < GetNumEdges().
The returned array view refers to internal storage; lifetime is tied to the owning TopologyRefiner and refinement state.
The TopologyLevel must be initialized by a TopologyRefiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetVertexEdges
functions.description: Returns a view of the edge indices incident to vertex v, ordered around the vertex.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetVertexEdgeLocalIndices

Consumers should align this array with GetVertexEdges(v) when iterating.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetEdgeFaceLocalIndices

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::IsVertexNonManifold

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetVertexSharpness

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::IsEdgeInfSharp

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetEdgeChildVertex
functions.description: Returns the child vertex index in the next refinement level that is generated from edge e (edge-point for the subdivision step).
requirements: e must be a valid edge index: 0 <= e < GetNumEdges().
This TopologyLevel must have a child refinement (_refToChild non-null).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetVertexChildVertex
functions.description: Returns the child vertex index in the next refinement level that is generated from vertex v (vertex-point for the subdivision step).
requirements: v must be a valid vertex index: 0 <= v < GetNumVertices().
This TopologyLevel must have a child refinement (_refToChild non-null).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::GetFaceParentFace
functions.description: Returns the parent face index in the previous refinement level from which face f was generated.
requirements: f must be a valid face index in this level: 0 <= f < GetNumFaces().
This TopologyLevel must have a parent refinement (_refToParent non-null).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::ValidateTopology
functions.description: Validates the internal topological consistency of this level for debugging purposes; returns true if valid.
requirements: Intended as a debugging aid; behavior and diagnostics depend on build configuration.
The TopologyLevel must be initialized by a TopologyRefiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::PrintTopology
functions.description: Prints a human-readable description of this level’s topology to stdout/stderr for debugging. If children is true and a child refinement exists, includes child-refinement relationships.
requirements: Output destination and format are implementation-defined (intended for debugging).
Safe to call regardless of whether a child refinement exists (function checks for null internally).
The TopologyLevel must be initialized by a TopologyRefiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::TopologyLevel
functions.description: Default constructor. Not intended for public use; provided to satisfy STL container requirements. Leaves internal pointers unset.
requirements: Do not use any member accessors on a default-constructed instance until it has been initialized by TopologyRefiner (internal pointers will be null/undefined).
Objects are normally constructed and owned by TopologyRefiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyLevel::~TopologyLevel
functions.description: Destructor. Not intended for public use; instances are owned by TopologyRefiner.
requirements: Do not retain references or views (e.g., ConstIndexArray) into this object’s internal storage beyond the lifetime of the owning TopologyRefiner or after re-refinement.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::TopologyRefiner
functions.description: Constructs a TopologyRefiner that stores and manages subdivision topology for a given subdivision scheme type and options. Typically used as the starting point before performing uniform or adaptive refinement.
requirements: type must be a valid OpenSubdiv Sdc::SchemeType supported by the build (e.g., Catmull-Clark, Loop, Bilinear).
options should be initialized; if omitted, defaults to a default-constructed Sdc::Options().
The created instance will initially contain at least a base level; further levels are added via RefineUniform or RefineAdaptive.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::~TopologyRefiner
functions.description: Destroys the TopologyRefiner and releases any owned refinement levels and related topology data.
requirements: All external references to levels or arrays owned by this refiner must not be used after destruction.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetSchemeType
functions.description: Returns the subdivision scheme type used by this refiner (e.g., Catmull-Clark, Loop, Bilinear).
requirements: The refiner must have been constructed; no additional state is required.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetSchemeOptions
functions.description: Returns the subdivision scheme options (Sdc::Options) associated with this refiner, including feature-varying and boundary rules.
requirements: The refiner must have been constructed; no additional state is required.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::IsUniform
functions.description: Returns true if the most recent refinement applied was uniform refinement, false otherwise.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetNumLevels
functions.description: Returns the number of topology refinement levels currently stored (including the base level).
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetMaxLevel
functions.description: Returns the highest refinement level index present in the refiner.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetMaxValence
functions.description: Returns the maximum vertex valence observed across all levels in this refiner.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::HasHoles
functions.description: Returns true if any faces have been tagged as holes in the stored topology.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetNumVerticesTotal
functions.description: Returns the total number of vertices across all refinement levels.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetNumEdgesTotal
functions.description: Returns the total number of edges across all refinement levels.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetNumFacesTotal
functions.description: Returns the total number of faces across all refinement levels.
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetNumFaceVerticesTotal
functions.description: Returns the total number of face-vertex entries across all levels (sum of each face's vertex count per level).
requirements: None beyond a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetLevel
functions.description: Provides read-only access to the TopologyLevel at the specified refinement level index.
requirements: level must be in the range [0, GetNumLevels() - 1].
The returned reference becomes invalid if Unrefine() is called or the refiner is destroyed.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::RefineUniform
functions.description: Performs uniform subdivision refinement according to the provided UniformOptions. It creates successive levels up to the requested refinement level. If fullTopologyInLastLevel is false, only minimal topology needed for interpolation is generated in the last level.
requirements: options.refinementLevel is effectively limited to 0..15 (stored in a 4-bit field).
When topology traversal at the last level is required (edges/incidence), options.fullTopologyInLastLevel should be set true.
Refiner must contain a valid base level before calling (created by the factory in typical usage).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetUniformOptions
functions.description: Returns the UniformOptions last used for uniform refinement.
requirements: If no uniform refinement has been performed, returned options reflect the refiner's default-initialized state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::RefineAdaptive
functions.description: Performs feature-adaptive refinement driven by AdaptiveOptions. Optionally restricts refinement to a set of selected base-level face indices. The algorithm isolates extraordinary vertices/creases up to the isolation level and may use special patches based on options.
requirements: options.isolationLevel and options.secondaryLevel are effectively limited to 0..15 (stored in 4-bit fields).
selectedFaces, if provided, must contain valid indices of base-level faces within [0, GetLevel(0).GetNumFaces() - 1] (inferred from parameter description).
Refiner must contain a valid base level before calling (created by the factory in typical usage).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetAdaptiveOptions
functions.description: Returns the AdaptiveOptions last used for adaptive refinement.
requirements: If no adaptive refinement has been performed, returned options reflect the refiner's default-initialized state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::Unrefine
functions.description: Removes all refinement levels, leaving only the base topology level intact.
requirements: Any references to non-base levels or their topology become invalid after this call.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetNumFVarChannels
functions.description: Returns the number of face-varying (FVar) channels defined on the base level.
requirements: The base level must exist; called on a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner::GetFVarLinearInterpolation
functions.description: Returns the face-varying linear interpolation mode configured for the specified FVar channel on the base level.
requirements: channel must be in the range [0, GetNumFVarChannels() - 1]; behavior is undefined otherwise.
The base level must exist; called on a constructed refiner.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactoryBase::prepareComponentTopologySizing
functions.description: Internal step invoked by the factory pipeline to finalize allocation/preparation after sizing of the base topology has been specified. Expected to allocate/prepare internal structures based on sizes set during resizeComponentTopology before any topology indices are assigned. Returns true on success, false on failure.
requirements: refiner must have its base level component counts and per-component relation sizes set (via resizeComponentTopology and the setNumBase* helpers) before this call
must be called before assigning actual topology indices (i.e., before prepareComponentTopologyAssignment)
caller must check the boolean return and abort construction on false

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactoryBase::prepareComponentTopologyAssignment
functions.signature: static bool OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactoryBase::prepareComponentTopologyAssignment(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner& refiner, bool fullValidation, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactoryBase::TopologyCallback callback, void const* callbackData)
functions.description: Internal step invoked by the factory pipeline after topology indices have been populated to complete construction of derived relations, run validation (optionally), and finalize the base level. When fullValidation is true, the provided callback is used to report topology validation errors with the given callbackData. Returns true on success, false on failure.
requirements: must be called only after all required topology relations have been assigned via assignComponentTopology (at least face-vertices, and optionally edges, vertex relations, and local indices)
if fullValidation is true, a valid callback should be provided that conforms to the expected ValidationCallback signature and callbackData must point to the user context expected by the callback
ordering of incident components for manifold topology is expected to be counter-clockwise; non-manifold vertices/edges should be explicitly tagged prior to this stage
caller must check the boolean return and abort construction on false

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactoryBase::prepareComponentTagsAndSharpness
functions.description: Internal step invoked by the factory pipeline after optional assignment of component tags (edge/vertex sharpness and face holes) to normalize and finalize these tag values on the base level. Returns true on success, false on failure.
requirements: must be called after assignComponentTags if any tags were specified
caller must ensure any referenced component indices for tags are valid within the base level
caller must check the boolean return and abort construction on false

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactoryBase::prepareFaceVaryingChannels
functions.description: Internal step invoked by the factory pipeline after optional face-varying topology has been assigned to finalize face-varying channels (create internal structures, validate counts, etc.). Returns true on success, false on failure.
requirements: must be called after assignFaceVaryingTopology if any face-varying channels/values were created and populated
face-varying value indices assigned per face corner must be within the declared value-count for each channel
caller must check the boolean return and abort construction on false

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<MESH>::Create
functions.signature:
template <class MESH>
static OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefiner* OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<MESH>::Create(MESH const& mesh, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<MESH>::Options options = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<MESH>::Options())
functions.description: Constructs a new TopologyRefiner from a client-provided mesh representation (MESH) using the TopologyRefinerFactory specialization for that mesh type. The factory drives a 4-stage pipeline: sizing, assignment, tagging, and face-varying channels. Returns a newly allocated TopologyRefiner on success or nullptr on failure.
requirements: a specialization for MESH must implement at least resizeComponentTopology() and assignComponentTopology(); assignComponentTags() and assignFaceVaryingTopology() are optional

mesh data must describe a consistent base topology; if only face-vertices are provided, the factory will infer remaining relations; if edges are explicitly provided, their related relations must be complete
if options.validateFullTopology is true, the specialization’s reportInvalidTopology() may be used to receive validation callbacks
returned pointer is heap-allocated and ownership is transferred to the caller; the caller must delete it when no longer needed
on failure (any stage returns false), the function returns nullptr and does not leak the partially created refiner

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::TopologyRefinerFactory<MESH>::Create
functions.description: Creates a new TopologyRefiner that shares the base level of an existing TopologyRefiner. Intended for making lightweight copies that can be refined differently while sharing the same base topology.
requirements: source must remain alive for the lifetime of the new TopologyRefiner, and its base level must be preserved
returned pointer is heap-allocated and ownership is transferred to the caller; the caller must delete it when no longer needed

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::IndexIsValid
functions.description: Returns true if the given Far::Index represents a valid index as defined by the underlying Vtr layer (i.e., not the invalid/sentinel value). Typical usage is to guard index access or to test against Far::INDEX_INVALID. This is a thin wrapper over Vtr::IndexIsValid.
requirements: Argument index must be a value of type OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Far::Index.
No other constraints are documented; callers may pass Far::INDEX_INVALID to test for invalidity. Return value is true for valid indices and false otherwise.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::GetTopologicalSplitType
functions.description: Returns the topological split type used by the bilinear subdivision scheme. For bilinear, faces are split into quads. Typical usage: query once to understand how refinement will partition faces.
requirements: No arguments required.
May be called on any instance of Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>.
No side effects; returns a constant value (SPLIT_TO_QUADS).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::GetRegularFaceSize
functions.description: Returns the face size considered regular for the bilinear scheme. For bilinear, a regular face has 4 vertices.
requirements: No arguments required.
May be called on any instance of Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>.
No side effects; returns a constant value (4).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::GetRegularVertexValence
functions.description: Returns the vertex valence considered regular for the bilinear scheme. For bilinear, a regular vertex has valence 4.
requirements: No arguments required.
May be called on any instance of Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>.
No side effects; returns a constant value (4).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::GetLocalNeighborhoodSize
functions.description: Returns the number of additional local neighborhood elements needed by the scheme for limit evaluation. For bilinear, this is 0.
requirements: No arguments required.
May be called on any instance of Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>.
No side effects; returns a constant value (0).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::ComputeEdgeVertexMask
functions.signature:
template <typename EDGE, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::ComputeEdgeVertexMask(EDGE const& edge, MASK& mask, Crease::Rule, Crease::Rule) const
functions.description: Computes the refinement mask for the vertex produced by splitting an edge under the bilinear scheme. In bilinear, this defers to the crease-edge assignment routine. The two Crease::Rule parameters are accepted but ignored for bilinear.
requirements: EDGE must be a valid edge descriptor compatible with assignCreaseMaskForEdge(edge, mask).
MASK must be a refinement mask type compatible with assignCreaseMaskForEdge(edge, mask).
The provided Crease::Rule parameters are unused in bilinear; any values are accepted.
Function does not throw; writes results into mask.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::ComputeVertexVertexMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::ComputeVertexVertexMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& mask, Crease::Rule, Crease::Rule) const
functions.description: Computes the refinement mask for an existing vertex when refining under the bilinear scheme. In bilinear, this uses a corner-style mask assignment. The two Crease::Rule parameters are accepted but ignored for bilinear.
requirements: VERTEX must be a valid vertex descriptor compatible with assignCornerMaskForVertex(vertex, mask).
MASK must be a refinement mask type compatible with assignCornerMaskForVertex(vertex, mask).
The provided Crease::Rule parameters are unused in bilinear; any values are accepted.
Function does not throw; writes results into mask.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCornerLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCornerLimitMask(VERTEX const& /*vertex*/, MASK& posMask) const
functions.description: Assigns the limit-position mask at a vertex treated as a corner for the bilinear scheme. For bilinear, the limit position equals the refined vertex position, so the mask consists solely of a unit weight on the vertex.
requirements: MASK must provide: SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool), VertexWeight(int) returning a reference/assignable slot.
VERTEX is unused by this function but must be a valid type to satisfy the template.
Function sets posMask to have 1 vertex weight (1.0f) and no edge/face weights.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCreaseLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCreaseLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Assigns the limit-position mask at a crease vertex for the bilinear scheme. In bilinear, crease and smooth cases reduce to the corner case, so this delegates to assignCornerLimitMask.
requirements: MASK must provide the same methods required by assignCornerLimitMask.
creaseEnds is accepted but ignored for bilinear; it may be any two-element integer array.
VERTEX must be a valid vertex descriptor type.
Function writes the same mask as assignCornerLimitMask into posMask.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignSmoothLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignSmoothLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask) const
functions.description: Assigns the limit-position mask at a smooth vertex for the bilinear scheme. For bilinear, smooth reduces to the corner case; this delegates to assignCornerLimitMask.
requirements: MASK must provide the same methods required by assignCornerLimitMask.
VERTEX must be a valid vertex descriptor type.
Function writes the same mask as assignCornerLimitMask into posMask.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCornerLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCornerLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& /*vertex*/, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask) const
functions.description: Assigns two tangent-direction masks at a corner vertex for the bilinear scheme. Tangents are ambiguous; this implementation derives two edge-based tangents from the first incident face, setting weights: each mask has 1 vertex weight (-1.0f) and 2 edge weights with (1,0) and (0,1) patterns respectively.
requirements: MASK must provide: SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool), VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
VERTEX is unused by this function but must be a valid type to satisfy the template.
Function sets both tan1Mask and tan2Mask to have 1 vertex weight and 2 edge weights, no face weights; caller must ensure mask storage can accommodate these counts.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCreaseLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignCreaseLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Assigns two tangent-direction masks at a crease vertex for the bilinear scheme. For bilinear, crease and smooth reduce to the corner case; this delegates to assignCornerLimitTangentMasks.
requirements: MASK must provide the same methods required by assignCornerLimitTangentMasks.
creaseEnds is accepted but ignored for bilinear; it may be any two-element integer array.
VERTEX must be a valid vertex descriptor type.
Function writes the same tangent masks as assignCornerLimitTangentMasks into tan1Mask and tan2Mask.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignSmoothLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_BILINEAR>::assignSmoothLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask) const
functions.description: Assigns two tangent-direction masks at a smooth vertex for the bilinear scheme. For bilinear, smooth reduces to the corner case; this delegates to assignCornerLimitTangentMasks.
requirements: MASK must provide the same methods required by assignCornerLimitTangentMasks.
VERTEX must be a valid vertex descriptor type.
Function writes the same tangent masks as assignCornerLimitTangentMasks into tan1Mask and tan2Mask.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::GetTopologicalSplitType
functions.description: Returns the topological split type used by Catmull-Clark (Catmark) subdivision, which is to split faces to quads. Intended for topology processing stages to know how refinement splits faces.
requirements: No arguments; callable on a Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK> instance.
Returns a value of enum/type Split; the caller should be prepared to handle SPLIT_TO_QUADS.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::GetRegularFaceSize
functions.description: Returns the size (number of sides) of a regular face for Catmull-Clark: 4. Useful for detecting or optimizing the regular case.
requirements: No arguments; callable on a Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK> instance.
Return value is 4 for Catmark.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::GetRegularVertexValence
functions.description: Returns the regular vertex valence for Catmull-Clark: 4. Useful for recognizing regular interior vertices.
requirements: No arguments; callable on a Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK> instance.
Return value is 4 for Catmark.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::GetLocalNeighborhoodSize
functions.description: Returns the local neighborhood size considered for Catmark masks: 1. Indicates the mask depends on immediate 1-ring connectivity.
requirements: No arguments; callable on a Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK> instance.
Return value is 1 for Catmark.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothMaskForEdge
functions.signature:
template <typename EDGE, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothMaskForEdge(EDGE const& edge, MASK& mask) const
functions.description: Builds the interpolation mask for an edge-vertex in the smooth (non-crease) case for Catmull-Clark. It sets vertex and face weights based on the number of incident faces, with an optional special handling for triangle-adjacent edges when triangle subdivision mode is smooth. The mask is written into MASK via its SetNum* and *Weight accessors.
requirements: EDGE must provide: int GetNumFaces() const; for the triangle option path with two faces, void GetNumVerticesPerFace(int out[2]) const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); Weight& VertexWeight(int); Weight& EdgeWeight(int); Weight& FaceWeight(int).
EDGE::GetNumFaces() must be >= 1.
If GetNumFaces()==2 and triangle subdivision mode is smooth, GetNumVerticesPerFace must fill the vertex counts for the two incident faces.
The function writes 2 vertex weights, 0 edge weights, and faceCount face weights; caller must provide a MASK that can store at least those counts.
No crease or boundary handling here; use appropriate crease/hard edge path outside this function.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCreaseMaskForVertex
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCreaseMaskForVertex(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& mask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Builds the subdivision mask for a vertex on a crease (including manifold boundary) in Catmull-Clark. The resulting new vertex is biased toward the original vertex with contributions from the two crease-adjacent edge neighbors indicated by creaseEnds.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); Weight& VertexWeight(int); Weight& EdgeWeight(int).
mask is configured to 1 vertex weight, valence edge weights, 0 face weights; caller’s MASK must handle at least valence edge weights.
creaseEnds must contain two valid and distinct edge indices into [0, valence-1].
The two indices in creaseEnds must correspond to the two crease edges incident to the vertex.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothMaskForVertex
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothMaskForVertex(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& mask) const
functions.description: Builds the subdivision mask for a smooth interior vertex in Catmull-Clark. Uses the standard Catmull-Clark smoothing weights distributed over the vertex, its incident edges, and incident faces.
requirements: Requires a manifold interior vertex: vertex.GetNumFaces() must equal vertex.GetNumEdges(); code asserts this.
VERTEX must provide: int GetNumFaces() const; int GetNumEdges() const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); Weight& VertexWeight(int); Weight& EdgeWeight(int); Weight& FaceWeight(int).
valence = vertex.GetNumFaces() must be >= 0; the function allocates valence edge and face weights; MASK must be able to store these.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCornerLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCornerLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask) const
functions.description: Builds the limit position mask at a corner (extraordinary or non-smooth) vertex for Catmull-Clark. The limit evaluates to the vertex position itself (weight 1.0 at the vertex).
requirements: MASK must provide: void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); auto& VertexWeight(int).
Configures 1 vertex weight, 0 edge weights, 0 face weights; MASK must support these.
VERTEX is unused by this function but must be a valid reference.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCreaseLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCreaseLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Builds the limit position mask for a vertex on a crease/boundary in Catmull-Clark. The limit is a convex combination of the vertex and the two edge-adjacent points along the crease specified by creaseEnds.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); auto& VertexWeight(int); auto& EdgeWeight(int).
Configures 1 vertex weight and valence edge weights, 0 face weights.
creaseEnds must be two valid and distinct indices within [0, valence-1] referencing the two crease-adjacent edges.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask) const
functions.description: Builds the limit position mask for a smooth vertex in Catmull-Clark. Handles the corner-degenerate case (valence==2) by delegating to the corner limit, specializes the regular case (valence==4), and otherwise applies the general Catmull-Clark limit formula over the 1-ring edges and faces.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumFaces() const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); auto& VertexWeight(int); auto& EdgeWeight(int); auto& FaceWeight(int).
valence = vertex.GetNumFaces(); function requires valence >= 2; if valence==2, it falls back to corner limit mask.
Configures 1 vertex weight, valence edge weights, and valence face weights (with face-center semantics disabled).
Caller should ensure the vertex is smooth (not crease/corner) for meaningful results.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCornerLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCornerLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask) const
functions.description: Builds two limit tangent masks at a corner vertex. Provides simple, provisional tangent estimates aligned with the first two incident edges, primarily as stubs/temporary implementation for corner tangents.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() const; valence must be >= 2 for meaningful tangents.
MASK must provide: void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); auto& VertexWeight(int); auto& EdgeWeight(int).
Both masks are configured to 1 vertex weight, valence edge weights, and 0 face weights; subsequent edge weights beyond the first two are explicitly zeroed.
These tangents are not derived from a full corner limit surface; they are simple directional stubs.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCreaseLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignCreaseLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Builds two limit tangent masks at a crease vertex. tan1 is oriented along the crease (difference of the two crease edge directions). tan2 spans across the interior faces between the leading and trailing crease edges, with special cases for single/regular/irregular interior spans based on the number of interior edges.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() const; int GetNumFaces() const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); auto& VertexWeight(int); auto& EdgeWeight(int); auto& FaceWeight(int).
tan1Mask and tan2Mask are configured to 1 vertex weight, numEdges edge weights, and numFaces face weights, with face-center semantics disabled.
creaseEnds must provide two valid indices into the edge/face rings, with creaseEnds[1] > creaseEnds[0]. They delimit the two crease edges and the span of interior faces/edges between them.
The indexing for edges/faces is assumed to be counter-clockwise and consistent between edges and faces, as the function iterates ranges between creaseEnds.
For interiorEdgeCount == 1, regular B-spline cross-tangent weights are used; for >1, Biermann et al. formulae are applied; for 0 (single face), a simple average across boundary edges is used.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_CATMARK>::assignSmoothLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask) const
functions.description: Builds two orthogonal limit tangent masks for a smooth vertex. For regular valence (4) it uses fixed stencil weights; for irregular valence it computes weights from eigen-analysis-based formulas dependent on valence. tan2 is obtained by a cyclic rotation of tan1 weights.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumFaces() const.

MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); auto& VertexWeight(int); auto& EdgeWeight(int); auto& FaceWeight(int).

If valence==2, this function delegates to assignCornerLimitTangentMasks (treats as corner). Otherwise it configures 1 vertex weight, valence edge weights, and valence face weights for both tan1 and tan2.
Masks expect a consistent cyclic ordering of edges and faces around the vertex so that rotation to produce tan2 is meaningful.

functions.description: Computes a blending weight in [0,1] for transitions when the parent and child vertex rules differ due to decayed sharpness. It examines both parent and child vertex/edge sharpness values to derive a fractional weight reflecting partial decay.

incidentEdgeSharpness must point to an array of at least incidentEdgeCount floats and must not be null when incidentEdgeCount > 0.
childEdgesSharpness must point to an array of at least incidentEdgeCount floats and must not be null when incidentEdgeCount > 0.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::GetSharpEdgePairOfCrease
functions.signature: void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::GetSharpEdgePairOfCrease(float const* incidentEdgeSharpness, int incidentEdgeCount, int sharpEdgePair[2]) const

void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothMaskForEdge(EDGE const& edge, MASK& mask) const
functions.description: Assigns the refinement mask for an edge-vertex created on a smooth interior edge under Loop subdivision. Vertex weights are 3/8 and adjacent-face weights are 1/8 (or reversed if the mask indicates face-center weighting via AreFaceWeightsForFaceCenters). functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignCreaseMaskForVertex(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& mask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Assigns the refinement mask for a crease/boundary vertex under Loop subdivision. The mask places 3/4 weight on the vertex and 1/8 on each of the two crease-adjacent edge neighbors indicated by creaseEnds, with zero weight on other edges.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() returning the vertex valence around the crease.

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
creaseEnds must reference two distinct edge indices within [0, valence).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothMaskForVertex
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothMaskForVertex(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& mask) const
functions.description: Assigns the refinement mask for a smooth (non-crease) vertex under Loop subdivision. For regular valence 6, weights are 5/8 on the vertex and 1/16 on each neighbor. For irregular valence, weights are computed from cosine-based formulae (beta from cos(2π/n)), producing vWeight = 1 - n*eWeight and eWeight = (0.625 - beta^2)/n.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumFaces() returning the number of incident faces (valence for Loop).

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
Caller must ensure valence >= 0; exactly valence edge weights are written.
Invoke only for smooth interior vertices; function does not check classification.

functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignCreaseLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Assigns the limit position mask for a crease/boundary vertex. Produces the B-spline curve limit weights of (1/6, 2/3, 1/6) along the crease: 2/3 on the vertex and 1/6 on each of the two crease-adjacent neighbors given by creaseEnds; all other edge weights are zero.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() returning the vertex valence.

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
creaseEnds must reference two distinct edge indices within [0, valence).
Caller must ensure posMask has capacity for valence edge weights; this function zeroes all then assigns the two crease ends.
Invoke only for crease/boundary vertices; no internal validation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& posMask) const
functions.description: Assigns the limit position mask for a smooth interior vertex. For valence 6: vWeight = 1/2 and each neighbor eWeight = 1/12. For irregular valence, weights are computed from cosine-based formulas with beta and gamma, resulting in eWeight = 1 / (n + 3/(8*gamma)) and vWeight = 1 - n*eWeight.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumFaces() returning the valence.

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
Caller must ensure valence >= 0; exactly valence edge weights are assigned.
Use only for smooth interior vertices.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignCornerLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignCornerLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask) const
functions.description: Assigns two limit tangent masks at a corner vertex. Uses scaled difference formulas to produce tangents consistent in magnitude with interior tangents. For valence ≥ 2, tan1 emphasizes the first neighbor and tan2 the second, both with a scale of 3.0; all other edge weights are zero.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() returning the valence.

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
Caller must ensure at least 2 incident edges; function writes indices 0 and 1 explicitly and zeros indices >= 2.
Use only for corner vertices; orientation/neighbor ordering must be consistent with the application’s convention.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignCreaseLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignCreaseLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask, int const creaseEnds[2]) const
functions.description: Assigns two limit tangent masks for a vertex on a crease/boundary. tan1 is aligned along the crease and oriented with the leading edge (creaseEnds[0]) using weights ±1.5 on the two crease edge neighbors. tan2 is oriented across the interior faces between creaseEnds[0] and creaseEnds[1]; its formula depends on the number of interior edges between the crease ends and is scaled for consistent magnitude. Regions outside the crease span receive zero weight.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() returning the valence.

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
creaseEnds must be two indices with 0 <= creaseEnds[0] < creaseEnds[1] < valence, defining the leading and trailing crease edges in CCW order.
tan1Mask edge weights are set to 0 except at the two crease ends where weights are +1.5 and -1.5; caller must ensure edge ordering matches the desired tangent orientation.

tan2Mask writes edge weights from 0..valence-1 with piecewise formulas depending on interiorEdgeCount = creaseEnds[1] - creaseEnds[0] - 1; weights outside the span [creaseEnds[0], creaseEnds[1]] are set to 0.
Use only for crease/boundary vertices; function does not validate manifoldness or orientation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothLimitTangentMasks
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_LOOP>::assignSmoothLimitTangentMasks(VERTEX const& vertex, MASK& tan1Mask, MASK& tan2Mask) const
functions.description: Assigns two orthogonal limit tangent masks for a smooth interior vertex. For regular valence 6, assigns fixed cosine/sine-like weights (with Root3/2 factors) around the 1-ring. For irregular valence, tan1 and tan2 edge weights follow cos(2π i/n) and sin(2π i/n) respectively, i = 0..n-1. Vertex weights are zero.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumFaces() returning the valence n.

MASK must define: typedef Weight; methods SetNumVertexWeights(int), SetNumEdgeWeights(int), SetNumFaceWeights(int), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); indexable accessors VertexWeight(int), EdgeWeight(int) returning assignable references.
Caller must ensure valence >= 0; exactly valence edge weights are written for each mask.
Use only for smooth interior vertices; edge ordering must be consistent and CCW to match the angular progression used for cos/sin.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeFaceVertexMask
functions.signature:
template <typename FACE, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeFaceVertexMask(FACE const& faceNeighborhood, MASK& faceVertexMask) const
functions.description: Computes the refinement mask weights for a face-vertex (a vertex generated at a face center). For all schemes, this is uniform averaging of the face's incident vertices (1/n per vertex).
requirements: FACE must provide: int GetNumVertices() const.
MASK must provide: using Weight; void SetNumVertexWeights(int); void SetNumEdgeWeights(int); void SetNumFaceWeights(int); void SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); Weight&/const& VertexWeight(int).
MASK::Weight must support division and assignment from float (1.0f/n).
faceNeighborhood must describe a valid face; GetNumVertices() must be > 0.
faceVertexMask is output; caller must supply storage for at least GetNumVertices() vertex weights.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeEdgeVertexMask
functions.signature:
template <typename EDGE, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeEdgeVertexMask(EDGE const& edgeNeighborhood, MASK& edgeVertexMask, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::Rule parentRule = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::RULE_UNKNOWN, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::Rule childRule = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::RULE_UNKNOWN) const
functions.description: Computes the refinement mask for an edge-vertex (vertex created at an edge mid-point), handling smooth, crease, and transitional cases. If parent/child crease rules are provided, they can short-circuit sharpness queries; otherwise rules are inferred using edge sharpness and scheme Options.
requirements: EDGE must provide: float GetSharpness() const; void GetChildSharpnesses(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease const&, float outSharpness[2]) const.
MASK must provide: using Weight; setters for counts (vertex/edge/face), SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool), and accessors for VertexWeight(i), EdgeWeight(i), FaceWeight(i).
If parentRule == Crease::RULE_SMOOTH or (parentRule unknown and edge sharpness <= 0), a smooth mask is assigned via assignSmoothMaskForEdge (scheme specialization dependent).
If childRule == Crease::RULE_CREASE or parent/child sharpness indicate a crease, a crease mask is assigned (0.5/0.5 on endpoints).
In transitional cases, the smooth child mask is attenuated and blended with 0.5 crease weights by the fractional parent sharpness clamped to [0,1].
edgeNeighborhood must refer to a valid edge; any required sharpness queries must be supported.
MASK::Weight must support basic arithmetic (+, *, assignment).
Caller-specified rules must correspond to valid edge cases: parentRule should be SMOOTH or CREASE (other values yield undefined behavior per comments).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeVertexVertexMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeVertexVertexMask(VERTEX const& vertexNeighborhood, MASK& vertexVertexMask, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::Rule parentRule = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::RULE_UNKNOWN, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::Rule childRule = OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::RULE_UNKNOWN) const
functions.description: Computes the refinement mask for a vertex carried over to the next level (vertex-vertex), accounting for parent and child crease rules and potential transitions (corner, crease, smooth, dart). If rules are not provided, they are determined using vertex and per-edge sharpness and the Scheme Options. In transitional cases, computes a local child mask and blends it with the parent mask by a fractional weight derived from sharpness.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() const; float GetSharpness() const; float* GetSharpnessPerEdge(float* outEdgeSharpness) const; float* GetChildSharpnessPerEdge(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease const&, float* outEdgeSharpness) const; float GetChildSharpness(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease const&) const.
MASK must provide: using Weight; count setters; SetFaceWeightsForFaceCenters(bool); accessors for VertexWeight(i), EdgeWeight(i), FaceWeight(i); GetNumEdgeWeights(); GetNumFaceWeights().
MASK::Weight must support arithmetic and assignment from float.
If parentRule is SMOOTH or DART, the smooth mask is assigned and returned immediately.
If childRule is RULE_UNKNOWN but parentRule is specified, childRule is assumed equal to parentRule (no transition).
When rules are unknown, the function will query sharpness to determine them using Crease(options).DetermineVertexVertexRule(...).
For parentRule == CREASE, the function expects VERTEX to expose per-edge sharpness sufficient to find the two sharpest edges (crease ends).
In transitional cases, the function allocates temporary buffers on the stack sized by GetNumEdges() for sharpness and local mask weights; callers should ensure reasonable valence.
vertexNeighborhood must be initialized with accurate sharpness data consistent with the Options' creasing method.
Caller-provided rules must be consistent with topology; providing invalid combinations is documented as undefined behavior in comments.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeVertexLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeVertexLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertexNeighborhood, MASK& positionMask, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::Rule vertexRule) const
functions.description: Computes the limit position mask for a vertex, given the vertex's crease rule at the final refinement level. For Smoooth/Dart, computes smooth limit; for Crease, uses sharp-edge endpoints; for Corner, uses corner mask.
requirements: VERTEX must provide: int GetNumEdges() const; float* GetSharpnessPerEdge(float* outEdgeSharpness) const (used when rule == CREASE).
MASK must provide: using Weight; setters and accessors required by assignSmoothLimitMask/assignCreaseLimitMask/assignCornerLimitMask per scheme specialization.
vertexRule must be a valid Crease::Rule: RULE_SMOOTH, RULE_DART, RULE_CREASE, or corner-equivalent; behavior is selected accordingly.
When vertexRule == RULE_CREASE, VERTEX must return per-edge sharpness enabling identification of the two crease ends.
Caller must supply an output mask with storage for weights required by the scheme's limit mask implementations.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeVertexLimitMask
functions.signature:
template <typename VERTEX, typename MASK>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Scheme<SCHEME_TYPE>::ComputeVertexLimitMask(VERTEX const& vertexNeighborhood, MASK& positionMask, MASK& tangent1Mask, MASK& tangent2Mask, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::Sdc::Crease::Rule vertexRule) const
functions.description: Computes the limit position and two tangent masks (T1, T2) for a vertex, given the final vertex crease rule. T1 is oriented towards the leading edge (first incident edge in CCW order). T2 lies in the tangent plane so that normal can be computed as T1 x T2. Tangent magnitudes are not normalized and may vary by configuration.
requirements: Same VERTEX and MASK requirements as the single-output overload, plus tangent-specific assign*LimitTangentMasks must be available in the scheme specialization.
vertexRule governs which set of limit masks are produced: smooth/dart, crease (requires finding crease ends), or corner.
Caller must supply three masks for outputs; MASK::Weight must support arithmetic. No assumptions should be made about the absolute magnitudes of T1/T2.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::HbrAllocator
functions.signature:
template <typename T>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator<T>::HbrAllocator(size_t* memorystat, int blocksize, void (*increment)(size_t bytes), void (*decrement)(size_t bytes), size_t elemsize = sizeof(T))
functions.description: Constructs a block allocator for type T that allocates memory in fixed-size blocks and tracks memory usage via an external counter and optional callbacks. Expected usage: instantiate for a type T that is default-constructible and provides a GetNext() accessor usable by the allocator to link free objects. The allocator will allocate blocks of blocksize objects at a stride of elemsize bytes, invoke placement-new for T on each, and maintain freelists; it updates *memorystat and optionally calls increment/decrement to track memory consumption.
requirements: memorystat must be a valid non-null pointer to a size_t that the allocator can read and modify.
blocksize must be a positive integer (> 0).
T must be default-constructible (used with placement new T()).
T must be destructible (its destructor is explicitly invoked in Clear()).
T must provide an accessor GetNext() returning a reference to a T* (or equivalent assignable proxy) so the allocator can read/write a next pointer; it must accept nullptr assignments.
elemsize must be at least sizeof(T) and suitably aligned for T; otherwise behavior is undefined.
increment and decrement may be null; if non-null they must be valid function pointers callable as f(size_t).
The allocator is not thread-safe; external synchronization is required for concurrent access.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::~HbrAllocator
functions.description: Destructor that releases all memory owned by the allocator by calling Clear(). Any objects previously returned by Allocate become invalid after destruction.
requirements: Must not be used after destruction; all previously allocated T* are invalidated.
If outstanding objects exist at destruction time, their destructors will be invoked during Clear().
No concurrency: callers must ensure no other threads access the allocator during destruction.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::Allocate
functions.description: Allocates one T instance from the allocator. If the free list is empty, allocates a new block of blocksize objects, constructs them via placement new, chains them on the free list, updates *memorystat, and optionally calls the increment callback. Returns a pointer to a default-constructed T with its GetNext() set to null.
requirements: T must be default-constructible; its default constructor will be called via placement new.
T must provide GetNext() returning a reference to a T* so the allocator can manage the free list; returned objects will have GetNext() set to nullptr.
Allocator instance must be valid and not concurrently accessed from multiple threads.

Sufficient memory must be available for malloc of blocksize * elemsize bytes when a new block is needed; otherwise allocation may fail and result in undefined behavior (no explicit error reporting in this code).
The returned pointer must later be returned to this same allocator via Deallocate (not freed with free/delete).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::Deallocate
functions.description: Returns an object previously obtained from Allocate back to the allocator’s free list. Sets obj->GetNext() to the current freelist head and updates the free count. An internal assert enforces that obj->GetNext() is null before deallocation.
requirements: obj must be a pointer previously returned by Allocate on the same HbrAllocator<T> instance.
obj must not have been deallocated already; its GetNext() must be null at the time of call (assert-enforced).
T must provide GetNext() returning a reference to a T* to allow linking into the free list.
Do not call delete/free on obj; ownership is managed by the allocator.
Not thread-safe; external synchronization required if used from multiple threads.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::Clear
functions.description: Destroys all objects managed by the allocator and frees all allocated blocks. For every allocated T in each block, explicitly calls the destructor, then frees the block memory, updates *memorystat, and optionally calls the decrement callback. Resets internal state and invalidates all previously returned pointers.
requirements: After Clear(), any T* previously returned by Allocate are invalid and must not be used.
T must be destructible; its destructor will be invoked once per allocated element.
Not thread-safe; do not call while other threads might be allocating/deallocating.
memorystat must remain a valid pointer during the call; decrement callback (if set) must be callable.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::SetMemStatsIncrement
functions.description: Sets or replaces the callback invoked after allocating a new block to report increased memory usage. Pass null to disable increment notifications.
requirements: increment may be null or a valid function pointer matching void(size_t).
May be called at any time; affects future allocations only.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrAllocator::SetMemStatsDecrement
functions.description: Sets or replaces the callback invoked when freeing allocated blocks (e.g., in Clear or destructor) to report decreased memory usage. Pass null to disable decrement notifications.
requirements: decrement may be null or a valid function pointer matching void(size_t).
May be called at any time; affects future frees only.
