The HbrFaceChildren<T> instance must have been properly constructed by the allocator before use

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::Initialize
functions.signature: template <class T> void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace<T>::Initialize(HbrMesh<T>* mesh, HbrFace<T>* parent, int childindex, int id, int uindex, int nvertices, HbrVertex<T>** vertices, int fvarwidth = 0, int depth = 0)
functions.description: Initializes an HbrFace<T> with mesh ownership, topology, optional parent linkage, and per-edge storage. Sets IDs, uniform index, depth, allocates edge and face-varying bit storage as needed, wires opposite/next relations, and registers incident edges with the provided vertices. If a parent is provided, the new face is inserted as its child at childindex.
requirements: mesh must be non-null and consistent with the provided vertices
vertices must point to at least nvertices valid HbrVertex<T> instances; each must be prepared to accept incident edges
nvertices must match the actual number of vertices in the face; values > 4 trigger dynamic edge storage allocation
If parent is non-null, childindex must be within [0, mesh->GetSubdivision()->GetFaceChildrenCount(parent->GetNumVertices())-1]
id and uindex should be valid indices for the owning mesh; they are stored verbatim
May allocate memory; callers should ensure matching Destroy() is called before object reclamation

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::Destroy
functions.description: Tears down an initialized HbrFace<T>. Detaches children and parent references, removes incident edges from vertices, frees dynamically allocated edge/fvar/stitch storage, clears intrinsic edges, and resets state. May trigger garbage collection of parent or vertices via the mesh.
requirements: Call only on a face that was previously Initialize()'d and not yet destroyed
The owning mesh must still be valid because mesh callbacks (DeleteFace, GarbageCollect, etc.) are invoked
Do not call concurrently with other operations mutating the same mesh or vertices

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetMesh
functions.description: Returns the owning HbrMesh<T> of this face.
requirements: The face must be initialized for the return pointer to be meaningful

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetNumVertices
functions.description: Returns the number of vertices (and edges) in the face.
requirements: Face must be initialized

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetID
functions.description: Returns the unique face ID assigned at initialization.
requirements: Face must be initialized

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetFirstEdge
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the first half-edge of the face. For nvertices > 4 this is the first entry in the dynamically allocated edge block; otherwise it is edges[0].
requirements: nvertices must be greater than 0
Face must be initialized; for nvertices > 4, internal dynamic edge storage must have been allocated by Initialize()

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetEdge
functions.description: Returns the half-edge at the specified local edge index around the face.
requirements: index must satisfy 0 <= index < GetNumVertices(); an assertion enforces this
Face must be initialized

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetVertex
functions.description: Returns the vertex at the specified local vertex index around the face.
requirements: index must satisfy 0 <= index < GetNumVertices(); an assertion enforces this
Face must be initialized and its edges must be valid

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetVertexID
functions.description: Returns the mesh-global ID of the vertex at the specified local vertex index.
requirements: index must satisfy 0 <= index < GetNumVertices(); an assertion enforces this
Face must be initialized and its edges must be valid

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetParent
functions.description: Returns the parent face in the refinement hierarchy, or NULL if this is a top-level (coarse) face or the parent link has been cleared.
requirements: The owning mesh must be valid to resolve the parent ID into a face pointer

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetChild
functions.signature: template <class T> void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace<T>::SetChild(int index, HbrFace<T>* face)
functions.description: Registers a child face pointer at the given child index and sets the child's parent to this face. Allocates the children array on first use.
requirements: index must satisfy 0 <= index < mesh->GetSubdivision()->GetFaceChildrenCount(GetNumVertices())
face must be non-null and initialized
This must be called only after this face has a valid id (asserts id != -1)

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetChild
functions.description: Returns the child face pointer at the given index, or NULL if the children array is not allocated or the slot is empty/out-of-range.
requirements: index must satisfy 0 <= index < mesh->GetSubdivision()->GetFaceChildrenCount(GetNumVertices()) to guarantee a non-null return when present
Face must be initialized; children are only available after refinement/initialization that sets them

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::Subdivide
functions.description: Creates (or returns existing) the face’s child vertex produced by subdividing this face according to the mesh’s subdivision scheme. Caches and returns the HbrVertex<T> representing the subdivided face center/child.
requirements: The face must be initialized and associated with a mesh that has a valid subdivision scheme
Safe to call multiple times; subsequent calls return the cached child vertex
Not thread-safe with concurrent mesh mutation

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::HasChildVertex
functions.description: Returns true if a subdivided child vertex has already been created for this face.
requirements: Face must be initialized

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::RemoveChild
functions.description: Clears the reference to the previously created child vertex (marks as absent) without deleting the vertex itself.
requirements: Only clears the internal reference; the mesh still retains the vertex; callers must ensure external consistency if they intend to delete the vertex separately

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::IsHole
functions.description: Returns whether this face is marked as a hole (to be omitted during subdivision/evaluation).
requirements: None beyond face initialization

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetHole
functions.description: Marks or unmarks the face as a hole.
requirements: No additional constraints; callers should ensure downstream algorithms respect the hole flag

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::IsCoarse
functions.description: Returns true if the face is marked as a coarse (top-level) face.
requirements: Typically set by mesh->Finish(); caller should not assume a particular value unless the mesh has been finalized

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetCoarse
functions.description: Marks the face as a coarse (top-level) face.
requirements: Caller should only set on top-level faces during or after mesh construction

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::IsProtected
functions.description: Returns true if the face is protected against garbage collection.
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetProtected
functions.description: Marks the face as protected from garbage collection.
requirements: Use on faces that are shared or must persist across mesh operations

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::ClearProtected
functions.description: Clears the protected flag, allowing the face to be garbage collected if other conditions permit.
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::IsCollected
functions.description: Returns true if the face is currently marked as collected (pending or after garbage collection).
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetCollected
functions.description: Marks the face as collected for the mesh’s garbage collection bookkeeping.
requirements: Intended for internal use by the mesh/GC system

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::ClearCollected
functions.description: Clears the collected flag.
requirements: Intended for internal use by the mesh/GC system

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::Refine
functions.description: Asks the mesh’s subdivision scheme to refine this face into children. Delegates to mesh->GetSubdivision()->Refine(mesh, this).
requirements: The face must belong to a mesh with a valid subdivision scheme
May allocate new child faces; not thread-safe with other mutations

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::Unrefine
functions.description: Removes child faces of this face via the mesh, tearing down the refinement level directly below this face.
requirements: Only call when it is safe to delete child faces; mesh must be valid
Not thread-safe with other mutations

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::HasLimit
functions.description: Returns whether this face supports a limit surface under the mesh’s subdivision scheme.
requirements: The mesh must provide a subdivision scheme implementing HasLimit(mesh, face)

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetMemStats
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of HbrFace<T> (sizeof(HbrFace<T>)). Note: does not include extra dynamically allocated memory for large faces.
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetFVarData
functions.description: Returns a reference to the face-varying data associated with the vertex at the given local index, scoped to this face if necessary.
requirements: index must satisfy 0 <= index < GetNumVertices()
The vertex at the index must be valid and capable of returning HbrFVarData<T> for this face

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::MarkUsage
functions.description: Marks this face as used by incrementing usage counters on all vertices in its support (the 1-ring of faces around each of its vertices). Ensures adjacency is established and may increment some vertices multiple times.
requirements: Face, mesh, and vertex adjacency must be valid
Should be paired with ClearUsage() to balance usage counters if used as a reservation mechanism
Not thread-safe with concurrent topology changes

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::ClearUsage
functions.description: Clears usage of this face by decrementing usage counters on all vertices in its support; may enqueue unused vertices for garbage collection and invoke mesh garbage collection.
requirements: Should only be called after a prior MarkUsage() to keep usage counters balanced
Not thread-safe with concurrent topology changes

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GarbageCollectable
functions.description: Determines whether the face can be safely deleted: requires no children, not protected, all incident vertices unused, and if a top-level face, removing edges will not create singular vertices.
requirements: Mesh/adjacency must be valid to evaluate vertex usage and singularity checks

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetHierarchicalEdits
functions.description: Associates a sequence of hierarchical edits with this face by storing an offset into the mesh’s edits array and applying edits relevant to this face in order until a non-relevant edit is encountered.
requirements: edits must point into the mesh-managed contiguous edit array returned by GetHierarchicalEditsAtOffset(0)
Each edit in the sequence should be ordered and queryable via IsRelevantToFace(this)
The mesh must remain valid while edits are applied

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetHierarchicalEdits
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the list of hierarchical edits associated with this face, or NULL if none.
requirements: Valid only if SetHierarchicalEdits was called (editOffset != -1)
Pointer refers to mesh-owned storage; do not free or write through unless API specifies

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::HasVertexEdits
functions.description: Returns true if any hierarchical vertex edits affect this face or its subfaces.
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::MarkVertexEdits
functions.description: Marks the face as having vertex edits. Typically called while processing hierarchical edits.
requirements: Intended for internal use when applying edits

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetDepth
functions.description: Returns the refinement depth of the face in the hierarchy (0 for coarse faces).
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetUniformIndex
functions.description: Returns the uniform index associated with the face, which may be shared with other faces and differs from the unique face ID.
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetUniformIndex
functions.description: Sets the face’s uniform index.
requirements: i should be a valid uniform index within the mesh’s indexing scheme

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetPtexIndex
functions.description: Returns the ptex index associated with the face, or -1 if not set.
requirements: None

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetPtexIndex
functions.description: Sets the ptex index associated with the face.
requirements: i should be a non-negative ptex index valid for the mesh’s ptex layout

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetNext
functions.description: Returns an lvalue reference used by the block allocator to link free-list nodes. Not intended for general application use.
requirements: Internal/allocator use only; callers should not rely on this for application logic

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetPath
functions.description: Computes and returns a hierarchical path from a top-level face to this face, consisting of the topface ID and a reverse-ordered list of child indices down to this face.
requirements: Parent links must be valid up to a coarse face; mesh subdivision must provide child counts per face
Asserts that the computed depth matches GetDepth() for non-zero depth faces

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::PrintPath
functions.description: Prints the face’s hierarchical path (topface followed by reverse-ordered child indices) to stdout.
requirements: Same as GetPath(); uses stdio (printf) for output

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetClientData
functions.description: Returns the client data pointer associated with this face stored in the mesh.
requirements: Mesh must support GetFaceClientData(id)

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::SetClientData
functions.description: Associates an opaque client data pointer with this face in the mesh.
requirements: Pointer is opaque to the library; lifetime management is the caller’s responsibility

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::GetSupportingVertices
functions.description: Fills the provided vector with a sorted unique list of vertex IDs in the support of this face (all vertices from all faces around each vertex of this face).
requirements: support vector is modified: it is reserved (capacity) and vertex IDs are inserted in order
Face and mesh adjacency must be valid; not thread-safe with concurrent mutations

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::isTransitionPatch
functions.description: Returns true if this face is marked as a transition patch in adaptive subdivision (based on _adaptiveFlags.transitionType). Available only when HBR_ADAPTIVE is defined at build time.
requirements: Only available when compiled with HBR_ADAPTIVE defined
_adaptiveFlags must be properly initialized by adaptive subdivision code

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace::hasTaggedVertices
functions.description: Returns true if any vertex of the face has the adaptive 'wasTagged' flag set. Available only when HBR_ADAPTIVE is defined at build time.
requirements: Only available when compiled with HBR_ADAPTIVE defined
Depends on HbrVertex<T>::_adaptiveFlags.wasTagged being valid; GetNumVertices() and GetVertex(i) must function correctly

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFaceOperator::operator()
functions.description: Abstract functor interface invoked with a reference to an HbrFace<T>. Implementers provide custom operations to execute on a face (e.g., visitors, processors).
requirements: Must be overridden in a derived class; this pure virtual function has no default implementation
Implementations may impose additional requirements on face state; callers should ensure face is valid when invoking

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<
functions.signature: template <class T> std::ostream& OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<(std::ostream& out, const HbrHalfedge<T>& edge)
functions.description: Stream insertion operator for HbrHalfedge. Writes a human-readable description of the halfedge to the provided stream, including whether it is a boundary edge and the IDs/representation of its origin and destination vertices. Typically used for debugging or logging.

edge must refer to a valid HbrHalfedge instance. The function tolerates null origin/destination vertices and prints “(none)” in that case.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetOpposite
functions.description: Returns the opposite halfedge (the halfedge with reversed orientation across the shared edge), or null if this is a boundary edge.
requirements: The returned pointer may be null for boundary edges; callers must null-check before dereferencing.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::SetOpposite
functions.description: Sets the opposite halfedge pointer and synchronizes geometric sharpness from the opposite onto this edge. Also copies the sharpness value back to the opposite.
requirements: opposite must be non-null.
opposite must correspond to the reverse-oriented halfedge of the same topological edge, within the same mesh.
Caller must ensure the mesh topology is consistent; otherwise behavior is undefined.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetNext
functions.description: Returns the next clockwise halfedge around the incident (left) face.
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face; otherwise internal pointer arithmetic is invalid.
Returned pointer is non-null when the face is valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetPrev
functions.description: Returns the previous counterclockwise halfedge around the incident (left) face.
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face; otherwise internal pointer arithmetic is invalid.
Returned pointer is non-null when the face is valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetVertex
functions.description: Returns the vertex at the origin of this halfedge, using the halfedge’s owning mesh to resolve the vertex ID.
requirements: This halfedge must be associated with a mesh and face.
incidentVertex must refer to a valid vertex ID in the mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetVertex
functions.description: Returns the origin vertex using the provided mesh to resolve the stored vertex ID.
requirements: mesh must be the correct mesh that owns this halfedge.
incidentVertex must refer to a valid vertex ID in mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetVertexID
functions.description: Returns the ID of the origin vertex of this halfedge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetOrgVertex
functions.description: Alias for GetVertex(). Returns the origin vertex via the owning mesh.
requirements: This halfedge must be associated with a mesh and face.
incidentVertex must refer to a valid vertex ID in the mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetOrgVertex
functions.description: Alias for GetVertex(mesh). Returns the origin vertex using the provided mesh.
requirements: mesh must be the correct mesh that owns this halfedge.
incidentVertex must refer to a valid vertex ID in mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetOrgVertexID
functions.description: Returns the origin vertex ID of this halfedge. Alias for GetVertexID().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::SetOrgVertex
functions.description: Sets the origin vertex of the halfedge by storing the vertex’s ID in the halfedge.
requirements: v must be non-null and belong to the same mesh as this halfedge.
Changing origin vertices arbitrarily can invalidate topology; use with care as noted in the comment.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetDestVertex
functions.description: Returns the destination vertex of this halfedge (origin of the next halfedge around the face).
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face and have a valid next halfedge.
Returned pointer may be null only if topology is incomplete; normally non-null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetDestVertex
functions.description: Returns the destination vertex of this halfedge using the provided mesh for vertex resolution.
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face and have a valid next halfedge.
mesh must be the correct mesh that owns this halfedge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetDestVertexID
functions.description: Returns the destination vertex ID (the origin vertex ID of the next halfedge).
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face and have a valid next halfedge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetFace
functions.description: Returns the incident (left) face of this halfedge.
requirements: This halfedge must have been properly initialized by its owning face (Initialize).
Returned pointer is non-null for a valid halfedge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetMesh
functions.description: Returns the mesh that owns this halfedge (via its incident face).
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetRightFace
functions.description: Returns the face on the right side of the undirected edge (i.e., the face across the opposite halfedge), or null if this is a boundary.
requirements: If this is a boundary edge, the return value is null; callers must null-check before use.
Opposite pointer must be set for interior edges.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetLeftFace
functions.description: Returns the face on the left side of this halfedge (the incident face).
requirements: This halfedge must be attached to a valid face.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::IsBoundary
functions.description: Returns true if this halfedge has no opposite, i.e., it lies on a mesh boundary.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::SetFVarInfiniteSharp
functions.signature: template <class T> void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge<T>::SetFVarInfiniteSharp(int datum, bool infsharp)
functions.description: Marks or clears the infinite-sharp flag for a specific face-varying (FVar) datum on this edge, mirroring the flag to the opposite edge if present.
requirements: The face and mesh must be configured with face-varying data storage (fvarbits must be allocated); otherwise this will dereference a null pointer.
datum selects an FVar channel by index; it must be within the mesh’s face-varying count.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::CopyFVarInfiniteSharpness
functions.description: Copies the face-varying infinite-sharp flags from another edge into this edge (and handles the special case where the source edge is geometrically sharp).
requirements: If this halfedge’s face does not have FVar storage, the function is a no-op.
edge must be non-null and should reference a compatible edge from the same mesh (same FVar configuration).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetFVarInfiniteSharp
functions.description: Computes or returns the cached “infinitely sharp” flag for a given face-varying datum on this edge based on FVar discontinuities across the edge. Also caches the result on both sides when an opposite exists.
requirements: The face and mesh must have FVar storage allocated (fvarbits) for this edge; the function uses the bit array without null checks.
datum must be a valid FVar datum index in the mesh.
The halfedge must be attached to valid left/right faces when present; if either face is missing it is considered FVar-boundary (infinite sharp).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::IsFVarInfiniteSharpAnywhere
functions.description: Returns true if the edge is geometrically sharp or if any face-varying datum marks the edge as infinitely sharp.
requirements: If the mesh has FVar data, GetFVarInfiniteSharp(i) will be invoked for each datum; thus FVar storage must be valid when FVarCount > 0.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetFVarSharpness
functions.signature: template <class T> float OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge<T>::GetFVarSharpness(int datum, bool ignoreGeometry=false)
functions.description: Returns the face-varying sharpness for the specified datum. If the datum is infinitely sharp, returns k_InfinitelySharp; otherwise returns k_Smooth. If ignoreGeometry is false and the geometric edge is sharp, marks the datum infinitely sharp and returns k_InfinitelySharp.
requirements: Requires valid FVar storage for this edge (as GetFVarInfiniteSharp is called).
datum must be within the mesh’s FVar datum range.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GetSharpness
functions.description: Returns the geometric sharpness value of the edge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::SetSharpness
functions.description: Sets the geometric sharpness of the edge, mirrors the value to the opposite edge if present, and clears masks on the adjacent vertices to force mask recomputation.
requirements: sharp is a floating-point value; typical ranges are scheme-dependent but not enforced here.
Adjacent vertices must exist; ClearMask assumes valid origin and destination vertices.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::IsSharp
functions.description: Returns whether the edge is considered sharp at the current or next subdivision level. next=false tests sharpness >= 1.0; next=true tests sharpness > 0.0.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::ClearMask
functions.description: Clears the subdivision evaluation masks on the two vertices adjacent to this edge. Intended to be called after edge sharpness changes.
requirements: Origin and destination vertices must be valid and initialized.
Vertices’ ClearMask() must be safe to call in the current mesh state.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::Subdivide
functions.description: Ensures the edge has a subdivided child vertex (edge midpoint) and returns it. Reuses the opposite’s child if it already exists, otherwise requests subdivision from the mesh’s subdivision scheme and records parentage.
requirements: The mesh must have a valid subdivision scheme (GetSubdivision() must return a valid object).
This halfedge must belong to a valid mesh and face.
May allocate a new vertex; caller should not assume stable IDs if topology is changing elsewhere.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::GuaranteeNeighbor
functions.description: Ensures the opposite face/edge exists by delegating to the mesh’s subdivision scheme. Used to create or connect the neighboring face where needed.
requirements: The mesh must have a valid subdivision scheme (GetSubdivision() must return a valid object).
This halfedge must belong to a valid mesh and face.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::HasChild
functions.description: Returns true if this edge already has an associated subdivided child vertex.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::RemoveChild
functions.description: Clears the reference to the subdivided child vertex for this edge (does not delete the vertex).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::SetCoarse
functions.description: Marks the edge as belonging to the coarse (control) mesh as opposed to a refined edge. Useful for boundary interpolation behavior.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge::IsCoarse
functions.description: Returns true if the edge is marked as coarse (control mesh).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedgeCompare::operator()
functions.signature: template <class T> bool OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedgeCompare<T>::operator()(const OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge<T>* a, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge<T>* b) const
functions.description: Comparison functor for sorting HbrHalfedge pointers by the path value of their incident faces (ascending).
requirements: a and b must be non-null.
a->GetFace() and b->GetFace() must be non-null and provide a valid GetPath() value that is comparable via operator<.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedgeOperator::operator()
functions.description: Abstract functor interface to operate on an HbrHalfedge in-place. Users derive from this class and implement the call operator to process edges.
requirements: Must be overridden in a derived class (pure virtual).
edge must reference a valid HbrHalfedge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedgeOperator::~HbrHalfedgeOperator
functions.description: Virtual destructor for HbrHalfedgeOperator. Allows safe deletion through a base pointer.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::operator<<
functions.signature:
template <class T>
std::ostream& OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<(std::ostream& out, const OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHalfedge<T>& edge);
functions.description: Stream insertion operator for HbrHalfedge<T>. Writes a brief, human-readable description of the halfedge to the provided std::ostream. The format is: optionally the prefix "boundary " if the edge has no opposite face, followed by "edge connecting ", then the origin vertex (via that vertex's own operator<< or the literal "(none)" if unavailable), followed by " to " and the destination vertex (likewise printed or "(none)"). Intended for debugging, logging, or diagnostic output.
requirements: out must be a valid, writable std::ostream reference; the function writes to it and returns it.
edge must refer to a valid HbrHalfedge<T> instance; it is accessed via const methods (IsBoundary, GetOrgVertex, GetDestVertex).

The type HbrVertex<T> must be stream-insertable (i.e., an operator<<(std::ostream&, const HbrVertex<T>&) must be available) to print vertex details; otherwise output falls back to the literal "(none)" only when a null vertex pointer is encountered.
No specific threading guarantees are provided; callers are responsible for synchronizing concurrent writes to the same std::ostream.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<
functions.signature:
template <class T>
std::ostream& OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<(std::ostream& out, const HbrVertexEdit<T>& path)
functions.description: Stream insertion operator for HbrVertexEdit. Prints the hierarchical vertex path (face id, subface indices, vertex id) and the first three components of the edit values. Intended for debugging/logging of a vertex edit.
requirements: out must be a valid std::ostream reference that is ready for output.
path must refer to a valid HbrVertexEdit<T> instance whose internal hierarchical path data (nsubfaces and subfaces[]) are consistent.
path must have at least 3 float values in its edit buffer (width >= 3) because the operator unconditionally accesses edit[0], edit[1], and edit[2].

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::GetVertexID
functions.description: Returns the vertex id (local to the face at the end of the hierarchical path) that this edit targets.
requirements: The HbrVertexEdit<T> object must be properly constructed so that the stored vertex id is meaningful in the target face context.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::GetIndex
functions.description: Returns the starting component index of the vertex attribute to edit (e.g., the first channel within a multi-component attribute).
requirements: The object must be initialized; callers should interpret the index according to the vertex data schema used by T.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::GetWidth
functions.description: Returns the number of components affected by the edit (the size of the edit vector).
requirements: None beyond the object being valid; callers should treat the returned width as the number of floats available via GetEdit().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::GetEdit
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the edit values. The number of valid floats is GetWidth().
requirements: The returned pointer remains valid as long as the HbrVertexEdit<T> object remains alive.
Callers must not write through the returned pointer; it is const.
Callers must not read beyond GetWidth() elements.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::GetOperation
functions.description: Returns the operation type of the edit (e.g., Set, Add, Subtract) as defined by HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::Operation.
requirements: None beyond the object being valid; callers must interpret the enum according to HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::Operation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::ApplyEditToFace
functions.description: Marks the specified face and, when at the correct depth in the hierarchical path, tags the target vertex as edited. Used during traversal to record that this face/vertex will receive a vertex edit.
requirements: face must be non-null.
face->GetDepth() must be comparable to this edit's path length (GetNSubfaces()); when equal, face must have a vertex at the stored vertex id.
The vertex id must be valid for the face (0 <= vertexid < number of vertices in face).
The face must belong to the same topology context that this hierarchical edit path refers to.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit::ApplyEditToVertex
functions.signature:
template <class T>
virtual void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexEdit<T>::ApplyEditToVertex(HbrFace<T>* face, HbrVertex<T>* vertex)
functions.description: Applies the edit to the provided vertex when the traversal is at the correct face depth and the vertex matches the targeted vertex id. Delegates to vertex->GetData().ApplyVertexEdit(*this).
requirements: face and vertex must be non-null.
face->GetDepth() must equal this edit's path length (GetNSubfaces()).
face->GetVertex(vertexid) must be the same object as vertex.
T (the vertex data type) must implement a method ApplyVertexEdit(const HbrVertexEdit<T>&) callable via vertex->GetData().
The vertex must belong to the provided face and topology.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::GetVertexID
functions.description: Returns the vertex id (local to the face at the end of the hierarchical path) that this moving edit targets.
requirements: The HbrMovingVertexEdit<T> object must be properly constructed so that the stored vertex id is meaningful in the target face context.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::GetIndex
functions.description: Returns the starting component index of the vertex attribute to edit for a moving edit.
requirements: The object must be initialized; callers should interpret the index according to the vertex data schema used by T.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::GetWidth
functions.description: Returns the number of components per key in the moving edit. The edit buffer contains 2*GetWidth() floats.
requirements: None beyond the object being valid; callers should treat 2*GetWidth() as the number of floats available via GetEdit() for two keys.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::GetEdit
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the moving edit values. The buffer length is 2*GetWidth() floats (two key values).
requirements: The returned pointer remains valid as long as the HbrMovingVertexEdit<T> object remains alive.
Callers must not write through the returned pointer; it is const.
Callers must not read beyond 2*GetWidth() elements.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::GetOperation
functions.description: Returns the operation type of the moving edit (e.g., Set, Add, Subtract) as defined by HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::Operation.
requirements: None beyond the object being valid; callers must interpret the enum according to HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::Operation.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::ApplyEditToFace
functions.description: Marks the specified face and, when at the correct depth in the hierarchical path, tags the target vertex as edited. Same behavior as HbrVertexEdit for moving edits.
requirements: face must be non-null.
face->GetDepth() must be comparable to this edit's path length (GetNSubfaces()); when equal, face must have a vertex at the stored vertex id.
The vertex id must be valid for the face (0 <= vertexid < number of vertices in face).
The face must belong to the same topology context that this hierarchical edit path refers to.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit::ApplyEditToVertex
functions.signature:
template <class T>
virtual void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMovingVertexEdit<T>::ApplyEditToVertex(HbrFace<T>* face, HbrVertex<T>* vertex)
functions.description: Applies the moving edit to the provided vertex when the traversal is at the correct face depth and the vertex matches the targeted vertex id. Delegates to vertex->GetData().ApplyMovingVertexEdit(*this).
requirements: face and vertex must be non-null.
face->GetDepth() must equal this edit's path length (GetNSubfaces()).
face->GetVertex(vertexid) must be the same object as vertex.
T (the vertex data type) must implement a method ApplyMovingVertexEdit(const HbrMovingVertexEdit<T>&) callable via vertex->GetData().
The vertex must belong to the provided face and topology.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<
functions.signature:
template <class T>
std::ostream& OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<(std::ostream& out, const HbrCreaseEdit<T>& path);
functions.description: Stream insertion operator for HbrCreaseEdit. Writes a human-readable summary of the edited edge path and sharpness in the form: "edge path = (<faceid> <subface0> ... <subfaceN> <edgeid>), sharpness = <value>". Useful for logging/debugging.
requirements: out must reference a valid, writable std::ostream.
path must refer to a valid HbrCreaseEdit<T> instance.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrCreaseEdit::HbrCreaseEdit
functions.signature:
template <class T>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrCreaseEdit<T>::HbrCreaseEdit(int _faceid, int _nsubfaces, unsigned char* _subfaces, unsigned char _edgeid, typename HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::Operation _op, float _sharpness);
functions.description: Constructs a hierarchical edge-crease edit that targets an edge identified by an edge index within the face reached by following a subface path from a coarse face. The edit operation (Set/Add/Subtract) and the sharpness delta/value are stored; application occurs later via ApplyEditToFace.
requirements: _nsubfaces must be >= 0.
If _nsubfaces > 0, _subfaces must point to an array of length _nsubfaces containing the subface indices used to traverse from the coarse face.
_subfaces may be null only when _nsubfaces == 0.
_edgeid is the local edge index within the target face and must denote an existing edge for faces the edit may be applied to.
_op must be a valid HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::Operation (e.g., Set, Add, or Subtract).
_sharpness is a floating-point value; final applied value will be clamped to [HbrHalfedge<T>::k_Smooth, HbrHalfedge<T>::k_InfinitelySharp].
_faceid must identify a valid coarse face when used in context (validated by the broader Hbr mesh system, not by this constructor).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrCreaseEdit::~HbrCreaseEdit
functions.description: Virtual destructor for HbrCreaseEdit. No special cleanup logic is defined in this header; destruction follows standard C++ object lifetime rules.
requirements: Object must be destroyed only once; ensure no dangling references remain.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrCreaseEdit::ApplyEditToFace
functions.description: Applies the stored crease edit to the given face when the face’s depth equals the edit’s subface path length. Computes a new sharpness by Set/Add/Subtract relative to the current edge sharpness, clamps it to the valid range, guarantees the edge’s neighbor exists, and assigns the sharpness to the targeted edge.
requirements: face must be non-null and refer to a valid HbrFace<T> instance.
The edit affects the face only if face->GetDepth() == HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::GetNSubfaces(); otherwise it is a no-op.
The edge identified by edgeid must exist on the provided face (edge index must be valid for that face).
This call mutates the mesh topology state by forcing the edge neighbor to exist (via GuaranteeNeighbor) and changes the edge sharpness.
Resulting sharpness is clamped to [HbrHalfedge<T>::k_Smooth, HbrHalfedge<T>::k_InfinitelySharp].

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::operator<
functions.description: Compares two hierarchical edits lexicographically by path so they can be ordered (e.g., for associative containers). Comparison order: faceid, then each subface id up to the shorter path, then path length (shorter is less if common prefix is equal). Intended for strict weak ordering of edit paths.
requirements: Both this and p must be fully constructed with valid subfaces arrays of length nsubfaces.
No additional preconditions; function does not modify state and does not throw.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::GetFaceID
functions.description: Returns the top-level face ID that begins this hierarchical edit's path. Use to identify the root face affected by the edit.
requirements: Object must be constructed; faceid is immutable once set.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::GetNSubfaces
functions.description: Returns the number of subface indices in this edit's path below the root face.
requirements: Object must be constructed; nsubfaces is immutable once set.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::GetSubface
functions.signature: template <class T> unsigned char OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::GetSubface(int index) const
functions.description: Returns the subface id at the given index in the edit path. Index 0 corresponds to the first subface below the root face. No bounds checking is performed.
requirements: index must be in the range [0, GetNSubfaces()).
The underlying subfaces array must be valid (object not destroyed).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::IsRelevantToFace
functions.description: Determines whether this hierarchical edit applies to the given face by comparing the face's first hierarchical edit path with this edit's path prefix. Returns true if both start at the same faceid and the face's depth-length path matches this edit's path prefix; false otherwise.
requirements: face must be non-null.
face->GetHierarchicalEdits() must be a valid, non-null pointer to storage for a HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>* (the function dereferences it before checking contents).
It is safe if the dereferenced pointer value is null; in that case the function returns false.
The face's depth must be <= this->GetNSubfaces() to be considered relevant (enforced internally).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::ApplyEditToFace
functions.description: Applies this hierarchical edit to a face. In the base class this is a no-op; subclasses override to implement face-level edits (e.g., face-varying data changes).
requirements: When calling overridden implementations, face is typically expected to be non-null and to correspond to the face identified by this edit; specifics depend on the subclass.
Base implementation imposes no requirements and performs no action.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit::ApplyEditToVertex
functions.signature: template <class T> virtual void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::ApplyEditToVertex(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace<T>* face, OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex<T>* vertex)
functions.description: Applies this hierarchical edit to a vertex referenced by a face. In the base class this is a no-op; subclasses override to implement per-vertex edits (e.g., crease weights or primvar edits).
requirements: When calling overridden implementations, face and vertex are typically expected to be non-null and consistent; specifics depend on the subclass.
Base implementation imposes no requirements and performs no action.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEditComparator::operator()
functions.signature: template <class T> bool OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEditComparator<T>::operator()(const OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>* path1, const OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>* path2) const
functions.description: Function object providing a strict weak ordering for pointers to HbrHierarchicalEdit<T> by delegating to HbrHierarchicalEdit<T>::operator<. Useful as a comparator in ordered containers of pointers to edits.
requirements: path1 must be non-null.
path2 must be non-null.
Both pointed-to edits must be valid for dereferencing during comparison.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::HbrVertex
functions.description: Default constructor. Initializes a vertex with invalid ID, no incident edges, zero references, zero sharpness, and cleared masks/flags. Typically followed by Initialize() before use when constructed via custom allocators.
requirements: No arguments.
Resulting object is in an uninitialized ID state (id = -1) until Initialize() or mesh code assigns an ID.
Not tied to any mesh until connected via incident edges/faces.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::Initialize
functions.signature: template <class T> void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex<T>::Initialize(int vid, const T &vdata, int fvarwidth)
functions.description: Initializes a freshly constructed vertex with the given ID, data, and face-varying width. Resets reference counts, flags, sharpness, parent, and incident-edge state. If fvarwidth > 0, constructs default face-varying storage in the object’s tail padding.
requirements: Must be called on a vertex that is not already bound/used (function resets state).
If fvarwidth > 0, the object must have tail padding for one HbrFVarData<T> (allocator upstream responsibility).
Asserts that no parent is set (parent.vertex must be null).
T must be copy-assignable.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::~HbrVertex
functions.description: Destructor. Calls Destroy() to release auxiliary allocations and clear parent/child links. Asserts that the vertex has no remaining incident-edge references before final destruction.
requirements: All incident edge references must have been removed before destruction (Destroy asserts references == 0).
Mesh-managed lifecycle is expected; typically vertices are deleted by HbrMesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::Destroy
functions.description: Finalizes the vertex if not already destroyed: asserts no incident-edge references remain, clears parent back-references, orphans child vertex (if any), frees extra face-varying storage, and marks destroyed.
requirements: Must only be called when references == 0 (asserted).
If the vertex has a child (vchild != -1) and mesh is provided, mesh->GetVertex(vchild) must be valid; the child’s parent pointer will be cleared.
Safe to call multiple times; only first call performs work (guarded by destroyed flag).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::AddIncidentEdge
functions.description: Registers an incident halfedge whose origin is this vertex, updating the internal list of incident halfedge cycles. Prefers storing boundary-cycle starters; consolidates/removes obsolete entries; maintains a deterministic first edge for non-boundary cycles. Increments the reference count.
requirements: edge must be non-null.
edge->GetOrgVertex() must be this (asserted).
Edge topology must be consistent (GetNextEdge/GetPrev/GetOpposite relationships valid) to allow cycle traversal.
Caller should not add duplicate edges; duplicates are tolerated but not re-added.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::RemoveIncidentEdge
functions.description: Unregisters an incident halfedge and updates the internal cycles accordingly. Handles removal of boundary and non-boundary edges, potentially removing or splitting cycles. Decrements the reference count and releases cycle storage when it reaches zero.
requirements: edge must be non-null and belong to the vertex (origin is this).
Edge topology must be consistent to compute next/prev/opposite.
May allocate or deallocate internal cycle arrays; callers must not retain raw pointers to incident.edges across calls.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::EdgeRemovalWillMakeSingular
functions.description: Predicts whether removing the specified incident edge would make the vertex singular (i.e., create multiple separate incident halfedge cycles). Uses current reference count and cycle configuration.
requirements: edge must be one of the vertex’s incident edges when meaningful.
Assumes consistent halfedge topology for GetNextEdge traversal.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::Finish
functions.description: Finalizes per-vertex flags after binding to a mesh. Splits singular vertices into multiple nonsingular vertices and marks whether the vertex is extraordinary using the mesh’s subdivision scheme.
requirements: The vertex must be attached to a mesh through at least one incident edge/face so GetMesh()/GetFace() succeed.
Mesh must have a subdivision object if extraordinary classification is desired.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetValence
functions.description: Computes the topological valence (number of incident edges), counting an extra for boundary endpoints. Assumes the vertex is not singular.
requirements: Vertex must be nonsingular (asserted internally).
Halfedge connectivity must be valid for ring traversal.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetCoarseValence
functions.description: Computes the valence using only edges marked as coarse (highest level). Adds one in boundary case as per data structure convention.
requirements: Vertex must be nonsingular (asserted).
Relies on HbrHalfedge<T>::IsCoarse() and valid connectivity.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetID
functions.description: Returns the unique mesh ID of this vertex.
requirements: ID must have been assigned by the mesh/initializer before use.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetData
functions.description: Returns a mutable reference to the application-defined vertex payload T.
requirements: Caller must ensure T’s invariants when mutating.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetFVarData
functions.description: Returns the face-varying data block associated with this vertex on the specified face. If no per-face block exists, returns the default overallocated block stored in the object’s tail.
requirements: face must be non-null and belong to the same mesh.
If per-face discontinuity storage was required, NewFVarData(face) must have been called beforehand to create it.
Object must have been allocated with enough padding for one default HbrFVarData<T>.
GetMesh()->GetTotalFVarWidth() must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::NewFVarData
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new face-varying data block for this vertex specifically for the given face, preserving and copying any existing per-face blocks. Initializes the new block’s FaceID.
requirements: face must be non-null; uses face->GetID().
Requires GetMesh()->GetTotalFVarWidth() to be correctly configured.
Uses malloc/new (placement) and may reallocate the entire array; previous pointers to morefvar contents become invalid after call.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetFace
functions.description: Returns a face incident to this vertex, specifically the left face of the current incident edge.
requirements: Vertex must have at least one incident edge; GetIncidentEdge() must return non-null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetMesh
functions.description: Returns the mesh that owns this vertex by querying the face from the incident edge.
requirements: Vertex must be connected to at least one face/edge so GetIncidentEdge()->GetFace() is valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetEdge
functions.description: Finds and returns the outgoing halfedge from this vertex to the specified destination vertex, searching all incident cycles. Returns null if not found.
requirements: dest must be non-null when used.
Requires valid halfedge connectivity to traverse cycles.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetNextEdge
functions.description: Returns the next halfedge around this vertex in counterclockwise order relative to the given edge, using prev/opposite navigation. May return null at boundary cycles to indicate the last step.
requirements: edge must be non-null and conceptually originate from this vertex (not enforced beyond comments).
Halfedge structure must have valid GetPrev()/GetOpposite() links.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetPreviousEdge
functions.description: Returns the previous halfedge (clockwise) around this vertex for the given edge, via opposite->next navigation.
requirements: edge must be non-null and conceptually originate from this vertex.
Halfedge structure must have valid GetOpposite()/GetNext() links.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetQEONext
functions.description: Quad-edge-like helper: given a destination vertex, conceptually advances to the next edge-on-vertex destination in CCW order. Uses traversal with boundary handling. Potentially expensive.
requirements: dest must be non-null.
Requires valid halfedge ring connectivity and ability to find the edge to dest if it exists.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetQEOPrev
functions.description: Quad-edge-like helper: returns the destination reached by traversing to the previous edge-on-vertex relative to the given edge. Uses opposite->next if available; otherwise falls back to vertex-based search.
requirements: edge must be non-null and have origin equal to this (asserted).
Halfedge connectivity must be valid; handles boundary cases.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetQELNext
functions.description: Quad-edge-like helper: returns the vertex reached by moving along the left face from the edge to dest (edge->GetNext()->GetDestVertex()), or reverse via dest->GetEdge(this) when needed.
requirements: dest must be non-null.
Halfedge connectivity must be valid; requires that an edge between the two vertices exists for a non-null result.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::OnBoundary
functions.description: Returns true if the vertex lies on a boundary, determined by the boundary status of its first incident edge. Singular vertices are considered boundary by definition.
requirements: Vertex must have at least one incident edge.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsFVarSmooth
functions.description: Returns true if the face-varying mask at the specified datum index classifies the vertex as smooth (mask == k_Smooth).
requirements: datum must be a valid face-varying channel index (0 <= datum < GetMesh()->GetFVarCount()).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsFVarAllSmooth
functions.description: Returns true if the vertex is smooth for all face-varying channels according to GetFVarMask.
requirements: GetMesh() and its face-varying configuration must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsFVarDart
functions.description: Returns true if the face-varying mask at the specified datum index classifies the vertex as a dart (mask == k_Dart).
requirements: datum must be a valid face-varying channel index.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsFVarCorner
functions.description: Detects whether the vertex is a face-varying corner for any incident face in the specified channel. A dart is considered a corner. Otherwise, it searches for two adjacent face-varying boundary (sharp) edges.
requirements: datum must be a valid face-varying channel index.
Requires valid halfedge connectivity for traversal.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetSharpness
functions.description: Returns the vertex sharpness value.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::SetSharpness
functions.description: Sets the vertex sharpness and clears the cached masks, forcing recomputation on next query.
requirements: sharp is typically within [0, k_InfinitelySharp] as per scheme conventions (not enforced).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsSharp
functions.description: Returns whether the vertex is sharp at the current level (next == false: sharpness >= 1.0f) or at the next level (next == true: sharpness > 0.0f).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::ClearMask
functions.description: Invalidates the cached vertex masks and volatility flag by zeroing them. Forces recomputation on next GetMask().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetMask
functions.description: Computes or returns the cached integer topological mask at the current or next subdivision level, considering vertex and edge sharpness. Also marks the vertex volatile if any adjacent edge is semisharp.
requirements: Halfedge ring and sharpness data must be valid.
next selects which cached mask to return: false -> current (mask0), true -> next (mask1).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetFVarMask
functions.description: Computes the face-varying mask at the specified channel by counting incident face-varying boundary edges and considering vertex sharpness.
requirements: datum must be a valid face-varying channel index.
Halfedge ring must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetFractionalMask
functions.description: Computes the fractional mask (0..1) at the current level by averaging fractional sharpness contributions from the vertex and adjacent edges. Asserts that at least one fractional contributor exists and that mask < count.
requirements: At least one fractional contributor must exist; otherwise an internal assert will trigger.
Halfedge ring and sharpness values must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsSingular
functions.description: Returns true if the vertex has multiple separate incident halfedge cycles (nIncidentEdges > 1).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetSurroundingEdges
functions.signature: template <class T> template <typename OutputIterator> void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex<T>::GetSurroundingEdges(OutputIterator edges) const
functions.description: Writes the ring of halfedges around the vertex to the output iterator in CCW order, handling boundary cycles by including the final previous edge.
requirements: edges must be an output iterator accepting HbrHalfedge<T>* values.
Halfedge ring connectivity must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::ApplyOperatorSurroundingEdges
functions.description: Applies the provided halfedge operator to each edge in the surrounding ring, handling boundary special case for the last edge.
requirements: op must be callable as op(HbrHalfedge<T>&).
Halfedge ring connectivity must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetSurroundingVertices
functions.signature: template <class T> template <typename OutputIterator> void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex<T>::GetSurroundingVertices(OutputIterator vertices) const
functions.description: Writes the set of neighboring vertices (connected by an edge) to the output iterator in ring order. Accounts for boundary by appending the last vertex from the previous edge.
requirements: vertices must be an output iterator accepting HbrVertex<T>* values.
Halfedge ring connectivity must be valid.
GetMesh() must be valid for mesh-aware accessors.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::ApplyOperatorSurroundingVertices
functions.description: Applies the provided vertex operator to each neighboring vertex in the surrounding ring. Handles boundary by also applying to the last vertex via previous edge.
requirements: op must be callable as op(HbrVertex<T>&).
Halfedge ring connectivity must be valid.
GetMesh() must be valid for mesh-aware accessors.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::ApplyOperatorSurroundingFaces
functions.description: Applies the provided face operator to each left face of the halfedges in the ring around the vertex.
requirements: op must be callable as op(HbrFace<T>&).
Halfedge ring connectivity must be valid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetParentEdge
functions.description: Returns the parent halfedge if this vertex’s parent type is k_ParentEdge, otherwise null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetParentFace
functions.description: Returns the parent face if this vertex’s parent type is k_ParentFace, otherwise null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetParentVertex
functions.description: Returns the parent vertex if this vertex’s parent type is k_ParentVertex, otherwise null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::SetParent
functions.description: Sets the parent to the specified halfedge and records parent type as k_ParentEdge.
requirements: Asserts that either edge is null or no parent vertex is currently set (internal assert).
Caller must ensure passed halfedge remains valid for the vertex lifetime or until parent is changed.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::Subdivide
functions.description: Ensures a child (subdivided) vertex exists for this vertex and returns it. If not already created, calls the mesh subdivision scheme to create it, records the child’s ID, and sets the child’s parent to this vertex.
requirements: Vertex must be attached to a mesh with a valid subdivision scheme (mesh->GetSubdivision() non-null).
Child retrieval via mesh->GetVertex(vchild) must be valid once created.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::Refine
functions.description: Refines the ring of faces around this vertex using the mesh’s subdivision scheme (RefineAtVertex).
requirements: Vertex must be attached to a mesh with a valid subdivision scheme.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GuaranteeNeighbors
functions.description: Ensures the existence of all neighboring faces and edges around this vertex via the subdivision scheme, marks neighbors as guaranteed, and applies any pending hierarchical vertex edits once neighbors are available.
requirements: Vertex must be attached to a mesh and subdivision scheme.
May traverse incident faces and apply edits; relies on valid halfedge ring.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::UnGuaranteeNeighbors
functions.description: Marks the vertex as potentially missing neighbors in the future and invalidates cached vertex masks.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::HasChild
functions.description: Returns true if a subdivided child vertex has been created (vchild != -1).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::RemoveChild
functions.description: Clears the reference to the subdivided child vertex by setting vchild to -1. Does not modify the child object itself.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsReferenced
functions.description: Returns true if the vertex still has at least one incident edge (references != 0).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsExtraordinary
functions.description: Returns whether the vertex is extraordinary based on the last classification (typically set in Finish).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::SetExtraordinary
functions.description: Tags the vertex as extraordinary.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsVolatile
functions.description: Returns true if the vertex is volatile (incident to a semisharp edge or semisharp corner). Computes mask if currently invalid to update volatility.
requirements: May trigger GetMask(false) if mask is invalid; thus requires valid ring connectivity.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsCollected
functions.description: Returns the GC collection mark for this vertex (used by HbrMesh).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::SetCollected
functions.description: Sets the GC collection mark on this vertex.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::ClearCollected
functions.description: Clears the GC collection mark on this vertex.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::HasVertexEdit
functions.description: Returns true if any hierarchical vertex edit exists for this vertex (flag only).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::SetVertexEdit
functions.description: Sets the flag indicating that a hierarchical vertex edit exists for this vertex.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::ClearVertexEdit
functions.description: Clears the hierarchical vertex edit flag.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetMemStats
functions.description: Returns the size of the HbrVertex<T> object in bytes.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsConnected
functions.description: Returns true if the vertex has at least one incident edge (nIncidentEdges > 0).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetIncidentEdge
functions.description: Returns a representative incident halfedge for this vertex: either the first entry of the cycles array or the single stored edge, or null if none.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IncrementUsage
functions.description: Increments an auxiliary usage counter used by mesh bookkeeping (distinct from incident-edge references).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::DecrementUsage
functions.description: Decrements the auxiliary usage counter.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::IsUsed
functions.description: Returns true if the auxiliary usage counter is nonzero or the vertex has a child.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetNext
functions.description: Returns a reference to an internal pointer slot used by the block allocator (aliases parent.vertex).
requirements: Intended for allocator/internal use only; external code should not rely on its semantics.
Returned reference becomes invalid if parent storage changes.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::GetClientData
functions.description: Retrieves the per-vertex opaque client data pointer stored in the mesh for this vertex ID.
requirements: mesh must be non-null and correspond to the mesh owning this vertex.
mesh must support GetVertexClientData(id).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex::SetClientData
functions.description: Sets the per-vertex opaque client data pointer in the mesh for this vertex ID.
requirements: mesh must be non-null and correspond to the mesh owning this vertex.
mesh must support SetVertexClientData(id, data).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<
functions.signature: template <class T> std::ostream& OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::operator<<(std::ostream& out, const OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex<T>& vertex)
functions.description: Stream insertion operator for HbrVertex<T>. Writes a short textual representation: "vertex <id>".
requirements: out must be a valid std::ostream.
vertex must have a valid ID to be meaningful.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexOperator::operator()
functions.description: Pure virtual functor interface applied to vertices. Users implement this to perform operations when iterating neighboring vertices.
requirements: Must be overridden by derived classes before use (pure virtual).
Implementations must be noexcept-safe or handle exceptions as appropriate for caller contexts.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertexOperator::~HbrVertexOperator
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the vertex operator interface.
requirements: Allows safe deletion through base pointer.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::HbrMesh
functions.signature:
template <class T>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh<T>::HbrMesh(OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrSubdivision<T>* subdivision = 0,
                                                    int fvarcount = 0,
                                                    const int* fvarindices = 0,
                                                    const int* fvarwidths = 0,
                                                    int totalfvarwidth = 0)
functions.description: Constructs a half-edge mesh that uses the given subdivision scheme and optional face-varying (FVar) layout. The mesh starts empty; vertices and faces are added later. If provided, fvar arrays define which FVar channels are present and their widths. Memory allocators and internal state are initialized; boundary interpolation options default to none.
requirements: subdivision may be null; if null, callers must not rely on GetSubdivision() being non-null.
If fvarcount > 0, fvarindices and fvarwidths must point to valid arrays of length fvarcount for the lifetime of the mesh.
totalfvarwidth should be the sum of fvarwidths; if non-zero, T must be compatible with HbrFVarData usage by this mesh (implicit library requirement).
Constructor is not thread-safe with other operations on the same object during construction.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::~HbrMesh
functions.description: Destroys the mesh, deallocating all faces and vertices and deleting owned hierarchical edits. Registered memory stat hooks are decremented appropriately.
requirements: All outstanding pointers to mesh faces/vertices become invalid after destruction; callers must not use them.
Do not call concurrently with other methods on the same instance.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::NewVertex
functions.signature:
template <class T>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrVertex<T>* OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh<T>::NewVertex(int id, const T& data)
functions.description: Creates or replaces the vertex with the specified id using the provided data, initializing its face-varying storage. Returns the created vertex pointer. The vertex is marked as a candidate for garbage collection and tracked as transient when transient mode is enabled.
requirements: id must be >= 0.
If a vertex already exists at id, its previous instance is destroyed; callers must not retain pointers to the replaced vertex.
The provided data must be a valid T compatible with this mesh's expected vertex type.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetVertex
functions.description: Returns the vertex pointer with the given id if it exists, otherwise returns null. Performs a bounds check against the current vertex array size.
requirements: id must be >= 0 to avoid undefined behavior.
If id >= current internal capacity (nvertices) or the slot is empty, the function returns null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetVertexClientData
functions.description: Retrieves arbitrary client data associated with the vertex id, or null if none is set or the id is beyond the client-data array size.
requirements: id must be >= 0 to avoid undefined behavior.
Client data lifetime and type are managed by the caller; this API stores and returns void* without ownership.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::SetVertexClientData
functions.signature:
template <class T>
void OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh<T>::SetVertexClientData(int id, void* data)
functions.description: Associates arbitrary client data with the given vertex id. If the client-data array is smaller than the mesh's vertex capacity, it is grown to nvertices before assignment.
requirements: id must be >= 0 and strictly less than the mesh's current nvertices; the function resizes only up to nvertices and will be out-of-bounds if id >= nvertices.
data is stored as-is; caller retains ownership and must ensure it remains valid for its intended use.
Thread-unsafe with concurrent mesh mutations.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::NewFace
functions.signature:
template <class T>
OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrFace<T>* OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh<T>::NewFace(int nvertices, const int* vtx, int uindex)
functions.description: Creates a coarse face from an array of vertex ids. If any vertex id does not refer to an existing vertex, the function returns null and no face is created. On success, the face is allocated, initialized, tracked for transient mode, and the mesh's maximum uniform index is updated if uindex is larger.
requirements: nvertices must be > 0.
vtx must point to at least nvertices integers.
Each vtx[i] must be a valid, existing vertex id in this mesh (GetVertex(vtx[i]) != null).
uindex can be any non-negative or negative int; it is used to update the mesh's max uniform index.
When transient mode is on, the created face is marked transient and may be purged by FreeTransientData().

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::NewUniformIndex
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new uniform index unique within the mesh by incrementing the internal counter.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::Finish
functions.description: Finalizes the coarse mesh. Marks existing faces as coarse and computes the number of coarse faces, finalizes connected vertices, applies boundary interpolation settings (sharpening boundary edges and corners as configured), and sorts and links hierarchical edits, appending a null sentinel.
requirements: Call after building the coarse topology (adding all intended coarse faces/vertices).
After Finish(), hierarchicalEdits is sorted and faces may hold pointers into that vector; do not reorder or free those edits until mesh destruction.
Boundary interpolation behavior depends on the current InterpolateBoundaryMethod settings.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::DeleteFace
functions.description: Removes and deallocates the specified face if it matches the current entry at its id. Safely no-ops if the id is out of range or the face pointer does not match the stored face.
requirements: face must be non-null, belong to this mesh, and match faces[face->GetID()].
After deletion, the face pointer becomes invalid and must not be used.
Caller should ensure the face is safe to delete in the current mesh state (e.g., no external references retained).

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::DeleteVertex
functions.description: Removes and deallocates the specified vertex if it is the vertex stored at its id, recycles the id, and destroys associated data. Used by GC and transient cleanup.
requirements: vertex must be non-null and belong to this mesh (GetVertex(vertex->GetID()) == vertex).
Only delete vertices that are not referenced by any faces/halfedges (vertex->IsReferenced() should be false) to avoid corrupting topology.
After deletion, the vertex pointer is invalid.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetNumVertices
functions.description: Counts and returns the number of non-null vertex slots currently in the mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetNumDisconnectedVertices
functions.description: Counts and returns the number of existing vertices that are currently not connected to any face.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetNumFaces
functions.description: Counts and returns the number of non-null face slots currently in the mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetNumCoarseFaces
functions.description: Returns the number of coarse faces. Uses the cached value computed in Finish() when available; otherwise counts faces marked coarse.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetFace
functions.description: Returns the face pointer for the given id if within bounds; otherwise returns null. No check for negative ids is performed.
requirements: id must be >= 0 to avoid undefined behavior.
If id >= current internal capacity (nfaces) or the slot is empty, the function returns null.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetSubdivision
functions.description: Returns the subdivision scheme associated with this mesh. May be null if the mesh was constructed without one.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetFVarCount
functions.description: Returns the number of face-varying data channels configured for this mesh.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetFVarIndices
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the array of start indices for configured face-varying channels, as provided at construction time.
requirements: The returned pointer is owned by the mesh and/or caller-provided during construction; it must remain valid for as long as it is used.

functions.name: OpenSubdiv::OPENSUBDIV_VERSION::HbrMesh::GetFVarWidths
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the array of widths for configured face-varying channels, as provided at construction time.
requirements: The returned pointer references memory whose lifetime must outlive its usage; typically the caller-provided arrays from construction.
